subject: What are your thoughts?
body:
After the Respect for Marriage Act was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law

|
---
| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zisdiv7apg9urpblbqf63m9t9k9lu2t116p5enq8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2c1geaor6chh2bs)
---
| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zdvleevsrmulkg804cori52ev24skte2v2nsb8jg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2c1geaor6chh2bs) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zmb007pot86a8psgqrekrhsc319226ct2qi9iqs8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2c1geaor6chh2bs)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z7ctn3sgl6kjf1b5laet69hm5cq3dbikq5a3vdng_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2c1geaor6chh2bs)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

#
Friend of Life,

Did you know that America's most popular diaper brands, including Huggies, Pampers, Hello Bello, and Honest Co., all support abortion?

This is peak irony. Brands that provide a necessity for babies also financially and/or publicly support an act that intentionally kills innocent children in the womb.

As pro-life people, we can do something to put a stop to this.

**Live Action is hosting a diaper drive with EveryLife -- the first pro-life diaper company -- to help mothers and their babies in need.**

If you're tired of supporting brands that don't align with your pro-life values, you can do something now to help women AND support a pro-life business.

**Your gift of just $50 will provide six packs of EveryLife diapers to a mom who is considering abortion or is facing a crisis and help her embrace life. We are searching for 100 people who can give before midnight so we can get diapers to local pro-life pregnancy centers nationwide. **

Is this something you can do? Here's your secure link to give: **[https://give.liveaction.org/send-a-box-of-diapers-to-a-mom-in-need/](https://email.alert.keepcongressrepublican.com/c/eJyM0T2PGyEQBuBfw3as2Nk1mILiFMdNdFG6lGgOxnvIfAmwk58f7SW6Ou18PNKr9-erfcUQQ96_YyJzd822bpFsRO4DVmqdP8GCgI0LxUHZdfLGaydRTmQWBSCUBgHTu9GLlNKfSEst6bY6r7cVhFwk0SLQ36ZgDkcoUEJv522bpdKgz16fNCh_kpJtAiO1Md-Jqit5b9R7o_p4i8Fhnl1JUzTvY9TO1hcGVwbXPTxpjuFJ6EYoeS5tZ3DtlD1H_lZ-83L7TDIKR55K4iHzTOQPYb0-RrK9PJojtl5qK72SGyHvDOSxSuTDI7H1QglD_Dd0mCqGPbP18he3Fd3dYq2EnzclD8rj4xPsy1f-7cuPEyzqPDXj668QY-hSsU3sB_wRbvxfA08DfwIAAP__bCqPFQ)**

EveryLife prides itself in being a pro-life company that uses premium materials for their diapers-- and better yet, EveryLife promotes the message that every baby is a miracle from God who deserves to be loved, protected, and supported.

Your gift will send a box of diapers to a local pro-life pregnancy clinic so that moms days away from a potentially life-ending decision can receive the practical support they need to choose life.

There's only a few hours to go and we haven't been able to reach our goal of 100 partners before midnight. Please consider **[donating right now before this opportunity expires.](https://email.alert.keepcongressrepublican.com/c/eJyM0T2PGyEQBuBfw3as2Nk1mILiFMdNdFG6lGgOxnvIfAmwk58f7SW6Ou18PNKr9-erfcUQQ96_YyJzd822bpFsRO4DVmqdP8GCgI0LxUHZdfLGaydRTmQWBSCUBgHTu9GLlNKfSEst6bY6r7cVhFwk0SLQ36ZgDkcoUEJv522bpdKgz16fNCh_kpJtAiO1Md-Jqit5b9R7o_p4i8Fhnl1JUzTvY9TO1hcGVwbXPTxpjuFJ6EYoeS5tZ3DtlD1H_lZ-83L7TDIKR55K4iHzTOQPYb0-RrK9PJojtl5qK72SGyHvDOSxSuTDI7H1QglD_Dd0mCqGPbP18he3Fd3dYq2EnzclD8rj4xPsy1f-7cuPEyzqPDXj668QY-hSsU3sB_wRbvxfA08DfwIAAP__bCqPFQ)**

Thank you in advance for standing with us against big abortion and equipping moms to choose life.

For Life,

Lila Rose
**President and Founder**

subject: These diaper brands are pro-abortion
body:
As pro-life people, we can do something to put a stop to this.

| [ ](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1a88ea5d7f1640ae862fb3528c48fc4b&_e=PBkPknYKv9S22lu8IbPqMUyt0qGAlEatMKbS2O1m7MQ6Q8lklWbjj36dtO2umygiyyJ6RvEMYpxEiEe4kTqzH6MDrlZ0shhvDIa3GqUQ-VxjhiQ69HV3PEZnSm88QXhiwdhVwsg1vx2DqiV9Z3i5C8xcVr-vEn4H77T9myUB2yn1KBunVRVebXkhl56fPxU-3tuWKTrSXMSjxStPD57KcnlWOmjjzw-eAGAvq9KBhybGxHo0pp_MriMBFkscC2JzcISFEafxtnIl9JE7CfUeoyx85zgL-He2s0XZZ8_iFuXH0X_yjC5B-BVSAE8yc7daqmai8UqHAp8ucZHEJtyD94XzpNo3VyqTgOttHBWNNoJX1ulIMzmAqYiKE8NQ0FolGU9ulBNv-rJ77v0sOMCumA%3D%3D)

#
Friend of Life,

Did you know that America's most popular diaper brands, including Huggies, Pampers, Hello Bello, and Honest Co., all support abortion?

This is peak irony. Brands that provide a necessity for babies also financially and/or publicly support an act that intentionally kills innocent children in the womb.

As pro-life people, we can do something to put a stop to this.

**Live Action is hosting a diaper drive with EveryLife -- the first pro-life diaper company -- to help mothers and their babies in need.**

If you're tired of supporting brands that don't align with your pro-life values, you can do something now to help women AND support a pro-life business.

**Your gift of just $50 will provide six packs of EveryLife diapers to a mom who is considering abortion or is facing a crisis and help her embrace life. We are searching for 100 people who can give before midnight so we can get diapers to local pro-life pregnancy centers nationwide. **
[](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1a88ea5d7f1640ae862fb3528c48fc4b&_e=PBkPknYKv9S22lu8IbPqMUyt0qGAlEatMKbS2O1m7MQ6Q8lklWbjj36dtO2umygiyyJ6RvEMYpxEiEe4kTqzH6MDrlZ0shhvDIa3GqUQ-VxjhiQ69HV3PEZnSm88QXhiwdhVwsg1vx2DqiV9Z3i5C8xcVr-vEn4H77T9myUB2yn1KBunVRVebXkhl56fPxU-3tuWKTrSXMSjxStPD57KcnlWOmjjzw-eAGAvq9KBhybZvLTqI8TDLG2l9DCqLSZ3afg5gPiD-KP12Q2dpby7kJfw0Iejt--BHgbEQDrOCqUPFAj6CG3QCNm4opDPzhwRGro5sbVCfy5ls-GxXWaDmCVwfjjrf1mHkdpiOg6z4IwQOZ8ZCgzYj9OwRa3l2skIhHQVNwV49Jo6CpZS55JnQg%3D%3D)
Is this something you can do? Here's your secure link to give: **[https://give.liveaction.org/send-a-box-of-diapers-to-a-mom-in-need/](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1a88ea5d7f1640ae862fb3528c48fc4b&_e=PBkPknYKv9S22lu8IbPqMUyt0qGAlEatMKbS2O1m7MQ6Q8lklWbjj36dtO2umygiyyJ6RvEMYpxEiEe4kTqzH6MDrlZ0shhvDIa3GqUQ-VxjhiQ69HV3PEZnSm88QXhiwdhVwsg1vx2DqiV9Z3i5C8xcVr-vEn4H77T9myUB2yn1KBunVRVebXkhl56fPxU-3tuWKTrSXMSjxStPD57KcnlWOmjjzw-eAGAvq9KBhybo2bZa_ed2foAP0mSFmOj7D4RkUaX935sThZhziNSe0k-16WKlhNDzYWoy4xWapAGtsEKdFr19ZTOKps-hn3lwMFojJvXKioAL3feJ5g9YWfkwwRN6q6VMHbp7w3_bTEB2s-JrgC0LlrMujYneISdzZSec5i5H4H2MVGuFunk5Jw%3D%3D)**

EveryLife prides itself in being a pro-life company that uses premium materials for their diapers-- and better yet, EveryLife promotes the message that every baby is a miracle from God who deserves to be loved, protected, and supported.

Your gift will send a box of diapers to a local pro-life pregnancy clinic so that moms days away from a potentially life-ending decision can receive the practical support they need to choose life.

There's only a few hours to go and we haven't been able to reach our goal of 100 partners before midnight. Please consider **[donating right now before this opportunity expires.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1a88ea5d7f1640ae862fb3528c48fc4b&_e=PBkPknYKv9S22lu8IbPqMUyt0qGAlEatMKbS2O1m7MQ6Q8lklWbjj36dtO2umygiyyJ6RvEMYpxEiEe4kTqzH6MDrlZ0shhvDIa3GqUQ-VxjhiQ69HV3PEZnSm88QXhiwdhVwsg1vx2DqiV9Z3i5C8xcVr-vEn4H77T9myUB2yn1KBunVRVebXkhl56fPxU-3tuWKTrSXMSjxStPD57KcnlWOmjjzw-eAGAvq9KBhyYaMOK2usZ_CC3Wbmt6J9FgiYM6yVOD3ggX3mDRIq8K7hUZ2vlQg4FXe7JzeEZabKq3aFTJb42G6DelsoSeKDHHn2m9nC3YPUqE0YBdaa5mkCht0pLoXp7ugBFP8LkLq4em0q5_bKbVUS3yGt-yJSwjH5JD1ONnAyXvf0rtAAOQkQ%3D%3D)**

Thank you in advance for standing with us against big abortion and equipping moms to choose life.

For Life,

Lila Rose
**President and Founder**

## Wildfires Rage Across More than 1 Million Acres
More than one million acres have burned across Oregon and California as wildfires continue to rage due to challenging winds and storms, hindering efforts by fire officials to contain the blazes. [See wildfire map here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAQQL8Gb0Hn4xycgSGt5C1dO1oYjpgKgmWoq_brq2bu9JYnPem93-abjSk-7m82s2mhzNa1ePCsT6hPSDN13gRmZNWx6TUijFqPqluN6nlY1OI5DOGiL24ZFj86dkO4EFlyXTQISKBR9wCISoKy4cwayJ31MAILAvaxlV1-lPhoK4f0XQ7epSu5S2ZtbatCXQVOAqcQ91xlLt5uVXKpPlb5sNXKezkETp81VIFTtttTV16oK9K6V6FeBMGpB5Qo8JVAwh9k_9Ptxm9fMaVYz1oQ3LON6dlu_584DP4GAAD__4pUXKg). Oregon currently has [38 active wildfires](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsULGOwyAU-xqyEb08CKQDwy1svfXGiCYv7buSUBFa1L8_pfNNtixbtvxzHs-BI2_X77CSK0saw1T4RaOVaCXqUTezW4iQVEOus4gwWDuo5uaC0SdUQNCdNIJZlOq7yQwXfQlm0sOpYYeAGizaDgBRtaDCYsiCnoztByChgWYuKbe_ibdyoyW-04tyO6W1ie5WymMX6kugF-hrre1zDyXN4X0YBPq9pPwW6Deq-wGhcNoE-qNWoAd78F6gT5muaZOV47xwJllymO6U5Roecn7mO5E8dIHe6l4P0PXwCTfZzY_KMfJurNBwXQPHz7ry_1cvh38BAAD__8CnaBQ), including the Durkee Fire, which is one of the largest in the nation. Officials believe that cooler temperatures, increased humidity, and light rain, all in the near forecast, will help with containment efforts. California's Park Fire is that state's largest, spreading to more than 164,000 acres in two days. Authorities have arrested a Chico man on suspicion he started the fire by pushing a burning car into a gully. ## Meat and Vegetables Recalled Over Listeria
U.S. health officials recalled [over 200,000 pounds of Boar's Head](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFyqzAQAL8GOnmOk8yJQsVr3Pm1KZkDnexLhPEIGSZ_n3HqlDvb7OzHdbyyZn3c_vMioaZ15LnqLiMZJINudG0MSQTFthI6QgRP5G17DxFTR8gRmQhTGvoz-ImEepeGTqRvNSCgA0LqABDtCSynXgjc3NPZgzQOJGpdy-lz1Ue9S8rf6y7lNK9Lm8O91ufW2H8NXhq88PMhx_ZWbyhV5ywNXrJuVYqyWV91KsJfJkpWswhXk3WXcrzKVg3yNHDEOFlw0ePggQaPfLZ-8HOcuraE-Dw0Z916ahzcFtb821H_vrIH_AkAAP__kSxjjA) liverwurst and deli meats on Friday due to a listeria outbreak that caused two deaths and left three dozen people sick. A sample of liverwurst from a Maryland store [tested positive for listeria](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFu4zAQRL-G6mjQK0orFyyuUedrrxSW4tLaC2UKJOPAfx8odboBBjN4eP_uy50kyfPxl3Z2LeaF1iYvXlADarCL7YKLzMB9x-6KAGZCnPpuczHEwSOug-_94MPqb0jeTtHzrTcUqBMHBqxBwKsxAP3F9BRHRmPXEYfJsLKGg7RcLv-zPNvGMb3zi8tlzXuX3NbaUVX_R8GsYH6-j1zbWSmYz2MFs8EzjwrmJJFreydWMPtMpeqNKejASfTO1KouvFJKHDTtEnSS2rgI6fzZfGH60EfJ_lx3xYXjS1KSOqKy5rGTpB-i9rufl4PvAAAA__8saGh0), prompting the recall of other deli meats produced on the same processing line on the same day, including bologna, garlic bologna, beef bologna, beef salami, Italian Cappy-style ham, and Extra Hot Italian Cappy-style ham. Listeria concerns have also prompted the FDA to recall bagged and bulk vegetables from an Ohio-based produce company. These products were sold at Walmart stores across 18 states. The recalled vegetables include cucumbers, peppers, green beans, squash, greens, parsley, and tomatillos that were packed between July 5 and July 12. On this day in 1940, Bugs Bunny made his first appearance in , an animated comedy short film released by Warner Bros. as part of the Merrie Melodies series. Elmer Fudd also appeared in the film and uttered his famous line, "Shh. Be vewy, vewy quiet. I'm hunting wabbits." At The Flyover , many of us come from different career backgrounds. Our staff includes former teachers, police officers, journalists, and a few lawyers. We would like to invite you to participate in today's poll. Let us know if you've ever switched careers. We hope you enjoyed reading today's Flyover. Let us know how we're doing by replying to this email. Our sponsor today is , connecting you with trusted advisors to help you plan for retirement. | Wildfires Rage Across More than 1 Million Acres More than one million acres have burned across Oregon and California as wildfires continue to rage due to challenging winds and storms, hindering efforts by fire officials to contain the blazes. . Oregon currently has , including the Durkee Fire, which is one of the largest in the nation. Officials believe that cooler temperatures, increased humidity, and light rain, all in the near forecast, will help with containment efforts. California's Park Fire is that state's largest, spreading to more than 164,000 acres in two days. Authorities have arrested a Chico man on suspicion he started the fire by pushing a burning car into a gully. Meat and Vegetables Recalled Over Listeria U.S. health officials recalled liverwurst and deli meats on Friday due to a listeria outbreak that caused two deaths and left three dozen people sick. A sample of liverwurst from a Maryland store , prompting the recall of other deli meats produced on the same processing line on the same day, including bologna, garlic bologna, beef bologna, beef salami, Italian Cappy-style ham, and Extra Hot Italian Cappy-style ham. Listeria concerns have also prompted the FDA to recall bagged and bulk vegetables from an Ohio-based produce company. These products were sold at Walmart stores across 18 states. The recalled vegetables include cucumbers, peppers, green beans, squash, greens, parsley, and tomatillos that were packed between July 5 and July 12. . Arsonists Target French Rail Network Arsonists disrupted France's high-speed rail network Friday morning, causing traveling to Paris, including Olympic athletes heading to the opening ceremony of the Olympic Games. ---|---
**Good morning!** On this day in 1964, San Antonio-born [Edward Higgins White II](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0z71u7CAQQOGngc4WzLJmXVDcxt3eNqXFz9iMgmEFyN68fZT06Y909H0816elRHn_bw80_b2V1fpOJ656AD2AWhUPxokwS45GagDxgPmueDRhE9bN0t1x836bvHDWBwgeFEzzJDUnAwKU0KCluE83MXqt_e0hEUBICw_HlMBAvdSxR-z4tm1LX-XEOvpy8GRi76_Gbv8YLAyW67rG3qItOVHGsdSdwRJtDq6UTwYL5l4J208ZqeOA4bI1DJH2nXIbiHg14XVRStQmzZTYD0vpd9X_kJ8GvgMAAP__c_VdVw) was selected as the pilot for the Gemini 4 space flight, a mission on which he became the first American to walk in space. We imagine that Ed White was received back from his Gemini flight more warmly than two cartel leaders were in El Paso this week. For all of you and your summer travels, we wish you safe journeys and warm welcomes, even if you're not walking in space.
We're interested in your feedback. Let us know what you think about _The Texas Flyover_!
We're flying today with our sponsors at [LMNT](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0j7FugzAQQL_G3oLuDhPbg4cubOlUqd3Qge1g1UBETjT9-6rtnPk9Pem9X4YLl1rW6ysvKcgjbwNPUo402BPZE5nB6BhGiB51CmiJwJHvjJ4DZmiZHRrOXYzMmEc02LJPbuTOe10CARmwZBG6cwvNZO3UOkxEgExuVAZSLLLtjcxJ0oPvuX5vR9qbaVt0DbPITbUvinpFfdzL-lmXVX6hor7_V98-9B7i7avUWu5nqwxcFy71ryBPho5APwEAAP__BMJNwQ), the sugar-free way to stay hydrated this summer.

## New Quake Hits West Texas

name: Douglas Carswell
subject: A strong voice for conservative Mississippi
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/educationstandards-11572881?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| Dear Friend,

**When did you first get a smartphone? So much has changed since then.**

For a start, the way we follow the news is today very different.

**Now if there’s a major news story, we often find out first not from cable news, but from social media.** A growing share of Americans get their news via their cell phones, rather than TV or in print.
---
|
---
_Old media, new media_
| In 2000, there were an estimated 50 million daily newspapers circulating in America. Today, there are less than 20 million. Newspapers are no longer primarily a print product, but read the way you’re reading this.

**Rather than lament these changes, here at MCPP we see it as an opportunity.** As Mississippi’s conservative voice, if our audience is primarily online, we need to be, too.

**If you are reading this, thank you. You’re one of 82,000+ people in the Magnolia state that have subscribed to get our Saturday email.** It has gone out every week at 6:45am since I took on this job, and it is our principle way to keep you informed.

**But the internet is evolving. **

**No longer primarily a medium of the written word, the internet is increasingly a medium of the moving image.** AI will only accelerate this change. News outlets that don’t adapt will soon feel as clunky as that first website your company had back in 1990 something.

We are investing time and effort to produce audio visual content that our audience wants.

**We have quietly built up a YouTube audience with over 9,000 subscribers.** Since the start of this month, over 23,000 individuals have watched thousands of hours of our output, as we discuss everything from the myth of the Mississippi "miracle" to George Soros.

Watch our YouTube Channel by clicking on the image below.
---
| [ ](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=41f1830015&e=5703353baa)
---
| We have also been posting audio content on our “** _Coming to America_** ” podcast. A steady trickle of listeners has turned into constant flow, and we aim to turn it into a torrent. Our podcast has already had over 50,000 downloads, mostly in Mississippi.

You can add “** _Coming to America_** ” to your regular podcast playlist on Apple, Spotify or wherever you access your podcasts.
---
|
---
| Have a wonderful weekend!
---
| [Forward this email to a friend!](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=8cbc4a4fce&e=5703353baa "Forward this email to a friend!")
---

---
Warm regards,

Douglas Carswell

He rebuilt our country after Donald Trump left it in shambles -- reducing prescription drug costs, upgrading our roads and bridges, fighting climate change, and more. We are stronger today because we took action -- together -- to invest in America’s future.
His legacy will be one of progress and empathy. Earlier this week, President Biden made the decision to step down as our Democratic nominee and offered his full support and endorsement for Kamala Harris.
**We are deeply proud of President Biden’s work and grateful for his service to our country -- and we’re ready to come together to elect Kamala Harris as the next President of the United States.**

Fellow American,

I'm Tim Sheehy. Those are also my pronouns. _**SHEE – He.**_

**That's a joke** , but it shows the lunacy we're living with in Joe Biden and Jon Tester's America.

I'm a former Navy SEAL. My wife is a Marine. I led Americans in the battle to defend our country. Then, we came home to live the American Dream in Montana.

We started an aerial firefighting business in our barn. We created hundreds of jobs and protected our public lands and Montanans from devastating wildfires.

I fight fires, so take it from me: the world is on fire under Joe Biden and Kamala Harris.

Consider their disgraceful retreat from Afghanistan. Joe and Kamala let our enemies steal our equipment—and kill 13 heroic American servicemembers.

_[**I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Montana to beat Jon Tester, the liberal Washington politician who supports Biden and Laffin' Kamala every time it matters.** ](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=8ade6d681b61401eb3a28f82aa174b4c&_e=820xihVlxvqRvIv8gpXjtLcQ2SUd2Z_AnmGgTIOGboMbrW7mEAe1S1B87vAPUtyucNNKUaD4hSEmjabR_Ii5WXhooUarbHt7vY9uUmqC48EKx3aeMDqpKSmTtxJVNKKLbpcEvmI3lyBQ7B2X9Ck6ytM-qUC9wwC5NZtSPx_tnDC1rNBP5ImvWlA-au-H37CMzZ4w3LmhIscDxRfTM6_4Xz_ujPtTLvrCLixO_94fe0Fu7y4X4uUtqBhKCxZCaLUGhcpD_6OQUm2jzAEIw_Zmxrn54gnZKpYKwlMStdtUWPPL6D4IEfuGSfHX767OGvp_sdVa5ptE3BLMn4uvZM24_rtsKQGDOLZYxYP9V2TJ79Lxizt9oXglD5FYwgIbzt2rz3VI2kw-YgLbzrvZMEZYqQ%3D%3D)_

Jon Tester is the deciding vote for the Left's America Last agenda. He got an F from the NRA. He voted to put a liberal judge on the Supreme Court who couldn't define what a woman is. He even drives a Prius in D.C.

[**SUPPORT TIM SHEEHY TODAY**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=8ade6d681b61401eb3a28f82aa174b4c&_e=820xihVlxvqRvIv8gpXjtLcQ2SUd2Z_AnmGgTIOGboMbrW7mEAe1S1B87vAPUtyucNNKUaD4hSEmjabR_Ii5WXhooUarbHt7vY9uUmqC48EKx3aeMDqpKSmTtxJVNKKLbpcEvmI3lyBQ7B2X9Ck6ytM-qUC9wwC5NZtSPx_tnDC1rNBP5ImvWlA-au-H37CMzZ4w3LmhIscDxRfTM6_4Xz_ujPtTLvrCLixO_94fe0Fu7y4X4uUtqBhKCxZCaLUGYMdNHvP3DgdaT8w-x8jbJTplpLPBrspZOaqfi4KOwKlv2LQNazrBpITXknY3_6K3P-vLT_HFyPtdWREp56fGRxMV9xQfaF0l7LqnpYe9BgZCq20LJn1yJ_Ish3yEkmrCbo8TwaR3t7t3ezy-Kvv_9Q%3D%3D)
Jon Tester doesn't represent Montanans. He's a rubber stamp for Biden and Kamala's failed policies. It's time to retire them all.

Listen, I'm an optimist. If you're not, you can't jump out of planes at night into enemy territory.

_I believe America's future will be better than our past._

However, we need political outsiders like President Trump to bring back common sense.

What Montanans think is common sense is pretty simple: They want a secure border, safe streets, and cheap gas. They think cops are good, criminals are bad, boys are boys, and girls are girls.

clean_body: We need political outsiders like President Trump to bring back common sense. | Fellow American, I'm Tim Sheehy. Those are also my pronouns. SHEE – He. That's a joke , but it shows the lunacy we're living with in Joe Biden and Jon Tester's America. I'm a former Navy SEAL. My wife is a Marine. I led Americans in the battle to defend our country. Then, we came home to live the American Dream in Montana. We started an aerial firefighting business in our barn. We created hundreds of jobs and protected our public lands and Montanans from devastating wildfires. I fight fires, so take it from me: the world is on fire under Joe Biden and Kamala Harris. Consider their disgraceful retreat from Afghanistan. Joe and Kamala let our enemies steal our equipment—and kill 13 heroic American servicemembers. Jon Tester is the deciding vote for the Left's America Last agenda. He got an F from the NRA. He voted to put a liberal judge on the Supreme Court who couldn't define what a woman is. He even drives a Prius in D.C. Jon Tester doesn't represent Montanans. He's a rubber stamp for Biden and Kamala's failed policies. It's time to retire them all. Listen, I'm an optimist. If you're not, you can't jump out of planes at night into enemy territory. I believe America's future will be better than our past. However, we need political outsiders like President Trump to bring back common sense. What Montanans think is common sense is pretty simple: They want a secure border, safe streets, and cheap gas. They think cops are good, criminals are bad, boys are boys, and girls are girls. I'm ready to retire Jon Tester and take back the U.S. Senate! Hi Peter,
My name is Dulé Hill, but you may know me as Charlie Young, President Bartlet’s personal aide.
The West Wing inspired an entire generation to get involved in politics, and I wasn’t immune. Like many who grew up with the show, I was left with the belief that we must come together to leave the world a better place than when we received it.
**That’s why I’m reaching out to you today, Peter. Our democracy is at risk this November.** Republicans have already succeeded in turning back time on women’s rights, and if they retake the Senate and the White House, they won’t stop there.
As a public figure, I believe it’s incumbent upon me to use my voice for good, **[so I’m asking you to support Bob Casey’s re-election campaign for U.S. Senate in Pennsylvania.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240727-1?refcode=em20240727-1&refcode2=3681_552475_IyzWa0&akid=3681%2E552475%2EIyzWa0)**
**Here’s why: The path to both the Senate and the White House runs through Pennsylvania, and if Bob Casey loses, Democrats don’t stand a chance.**
While Bob is fighting to protect women’s rights, workers’ rights, and voting rights, Republicans like his opponent are working to ban abortion nationwide, gut Medicare and Medicaid, roll back environmental protections, and cut taxes for the top 1%.
This November is about defending our democracy and our fundamental rights – and that’s only possible if we keep Pennsylvania blue.
**[So please, join me in the fight for the soul of our nation by chipping in $5 or $10 to Bob Casey’s re-election campaign today.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240727-1?refcode=em20240727-1&refcode2=3681_552475_IyzWa0&akid=3681%2E552475%2EIyzWa0)**

Hi Friend, it’s Carole King 🎶 and I personally wrote this email.
[**If you already know why we need Elissa Slotkin in the U.S. Senate, click here right now—really, every dollar helps!—and have a great rest of your day!**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-july24.5Fk0a0&refcode=em240727-1-900&t=3&akid=1699%2E135344%2EIZYeIn)
Elissa is an incredible candidate with a compelling story. You might know that she served three tours in Iraq alongside our military before working in national security under two presidents. But I want to share with you some of our recent conversations in which I learned why being a public servant is personal for Elissa.
After comforting families and survivors of not just one but two school shootings in Michigan (Oxford and Michigan State University), Elissa became even more fierce in her determination to stop the #1 killer of children in the United States: gun violence.
“People protested against seat belts in the 80s,” she told me, “but common sense prevailed, and millions of lives have been saved. We need to get this done!”
We CAN get this done if we elect people like Elissa who aren’t beholden to the gun lobby. People with common sense. People who care.

Friend, I know you’re getting a lot of emails. I am too. But even a dollar from each of us adds up to our grassroots power up and down the ballot.
A Democratic Senate majority is vital to defeat the candidates who flat-out lie to us (Unity? Really?). Billionaire donors can’t wait for Republicans to cut their taxes while yours go up—and Elissa’s likely opponent in November is on board with that.
For Elissa, serving the public is personal. She knows about the high cost of medical care. Her mom was diagnosed with cancer in 2009 and passed away in 2011. And she knows what it’s like to agonize over a family budget in the wake of high medical expenses.
[**You can count on Elissa to vote for dignity, our democracy, rights, freedoms, safety, healthcare, Medicare, and Social Security. You can count on her to lift small business owners, students, farmers, working families, seniors, and our most vulnerable neighbors.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-july24.5Fk0a0&refcode=em240727-1-900&t=28&akid=1699%2E135344%2EIZYeIn)
Thank you for doing whatever you can to elect Elissa and other Democrats.
Together, we can do this.
My best to you and your family, always,
Carole

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: A hope-filled study of the book of Revelation
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWkHln2WsN
Do you ever despair that Jesus will never return?
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWkHln2WsN

Hello
Friend,
Do you
ever despair that Jesus will never return?
When we
all get to Heaven, what a day of rejoicing that will be!
When we
all see Jesus, we'll sing and shout the victory!
The words
of this old hymn say it perfectly ... Christ's return is going to
be glorious!
But
between now and then, how should we live? What does God's Word
say about end times? As the world grows increasingly sinful ...
what should our response be?

When I
have those kinds of questions, I turn to the book of Revelation,
which I've found helps provide answers and strength in these dark
days.
And
today, I'm pleased to offer you my verse-by-verse study of the
book of Revelation entitled Final Conquest.
Final
Conquest is my first commentary on the book of Revelation. It's
all about the return of Jesus Christ, the most hope-filled event
in human history.
This book
will help you face the future with confidence! God doesn't want
you to live in fear. Final Conquest will unpack God's plan as
never before - you'll be encouraged!

With your
generous donation to Pathway to Victory-- to help keep our
ministry strong, for you and your family, and for listeners and
viewers across the country--I will send you a copy of Final
Conquest for free!
You can
make your most generous donation here:
https://secure.ptv.org/final-conquest-generous-gift-kit-1
One day
soon the darkness will pass...and our long-awaited King of kings
and Lord of lords will return and make His final conquest.
Until
that moment, we are focusing our hope on Christ and working
together to proclaim the gospel and expand His coming kingdom.

Sincerely,
Dr.
Robert Jeffress
Senior
Pastor, First Baptist Dallas

---
Friend -- Monday night at 8:30 pm EDT Jose Vega and I will lead a follow up of last Monday's excellent discussion, again with experienced intelligence professionals, including VIPS co-founder and former CIA analyst Ray McGovern. In the wake of Biden's withdrawal from the campaign, and the Chinese diplomacy for peace in both the Israel/Palestine and Ukraine/Russia conflicts, a strong American voice is urgent, but no one knows who's running the country right now. An informed citizenry must be part of this dialogue! | [](https://www.sareforsenate.com/committee_for_reason_20240730?e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240729_council_of_reason&n=2 "RSVP for Zoom Link for Mon. 8:30 pm") [RSVP for Zoom Link for Mon. 8:30 pm](https://www.sareforsenate.com/committee_for_reason_20240730?e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240729_council_of_reason&n=2)

body:
#
Hi Friend — Growing up, I was diagnosed with a serious illness and spent three months in the hospital. When I got better, my grandparents, who raised me, began looking for an insurance policy that would cover me in the future.
But they couldn’t find such a policy because of my previous illness. Not from any insurer. Not at any price. They had to pay for my health care out of pocket and make enormous sacrifices to do so — all because I had a pre-existing condition.
**That’s why I got into public service.** I saw my grandparents stay up late at night, worried sick that I would fall ill again and that they wouldn't be able to afford my care. I thought no one should ever have to go through that.
But I knew they weren’t the only ones. I’m one of 133 million Americans who have the label "pre-existing condition" attached to our care — and before the Affordable Care Act was passed, many of us could be denied coverage.
Now, insurance companies can no longer discriminate against someone based on their pre-existing condition. I championed health reform and wrote the amendment to allow young people to stay on their parent’s insurance plan up to age 26. Now, when I meet with young people across Wisconsin, almost every hand in the room goes up when I ask who is on their parent’s health insurance.
So, you can imagine my frustration whenever Republicans attack our health care or threaten protections for folks with pre-existing conditions — **including my Republican opponent who called my amendment a “stupid idea” and said young people on their parent’s health insurance need to “grow up and move on.”**
If Eric Hovde flips this seat and secures the Senate majority for Republicans, the ACA will be on the chopping block and countless Americans could find themselves in a place where insurance companies, once again, write all the rules. That’s why I need your help to defeat him.

clean_body: Hi Friend — Growing up, I was diagnosed with a serious illness and spent three months in the hospital. When I got better, my grandparents, who raised me, began looking for an insurance policy that would cover me in the future. But they couldn’t find such a policy because of my previous illness. Not from any insurer. Not at any price. They had to pay for my health care out of pocket and make enormous sacrifices to do so — all because I had a pre-existing condition. That’s why I got into public service. I saw my grandparents stay up late at night, worried sick that I would fall ill again and that they wouldn't be able to afford my care. I thought no one should ever have to go through that. But I knew they weren’t the only ones. I’m one of 133 million Americans who have the label "pre-existing condition" attached to our care — and before the Affordable Care Act was passed, many of us could be denied coverage. Now, insurance companies can no longer discriminate against someone based on their pre-existing condition. I championed health reform and wrote the amendment to allow young people to stay on their parent’s insurance plan up to age 26. Now, when I meet with young people across Wisconsin, almost every hand in the room goes up when I ask who is on their parent’s health insurance. So, you can imagine my frustration whenever Republicans attack our health care or threaten protections for folks with pre-existing conditions — including my Republican opponent who called my amendment a “stupid idea” and said young people on their parent’s health insurance need to “grow up and move on.” If Eric Hovde flips this seat and secures the Senate majority for Republicans, the ACA will be on the chopping block and countless Americans could find themselves in a place where insurance companies, once again, write all the rules. That’s why I need your help to defeat him. If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly. | | ** | | | | | | | ** Thank you, Tammy

We always knew that this would be one of the closest races in the country. That’s no secret. But we’ve been really fortunate so far because month after month we have absolutely crushed Kari Lake’s fundraising numbers. That gives us a tremendous advantage, and it lets us deliver our message to the people who need to hear it.
Friends, Kari Lake directly addressed the Republican National Convention.
She had a prime-time slot, one of the biggest of the night. I’m not going to speculate on how many people watched, but I can tell you one thing for sure: It was the biggest platform she’s ever had.
We always knew that this would be one of the closest races in the country. That’s no secret. name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: A historic moment and the case for your support
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the New Democrat Coalition Action Fund
body:
| Friend,

We are emerging from an unprecedented moment in our nation’s history, and a historic turning point that we will look back on for decades to come. # [Read My Vision Zero Street Safety Op-Ed](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..rB9xAqO2kG9UPmATofOIx0p8a8P-ZxUF22BfDiCOAeg/s/2950175210/br/246464936679-l)
---
_Photo by Leah Tribble._

Neighbors, our pedestrian safety crisis is real, and it is getting worse. That's why I wrote a piece in IndyStar last week urging the City-County Council to pass its Vision Zero ordinance and keep working to make our streets safer for all. I am glad to share that [the proposal has passed committee](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMDcsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vbWlycm9yaW5keS5vcmcvdmlzaW9uLXplcm8tcGxhbi10by1lbmQtdHJhZmZpYy1mYXRhbGl0aWVzLWJ5LTIwMzUtbW92ZXMtZm9yd2FyZC8iLCJidWxsZXRpbl9pZCI6IjIwMjQwNzI3Ljk4MjEyMDExIn0.HKOSGv2AViwEZK7Qfvj3xkBA9SbUgdlWUsuZaZbz0KA/s/2950175210/br/246464936679-l) and will soon go before the full Council for a final vote.

Vision Zero programs relocate the onus to prevent dangerous road incidents from individuals to the system as a whole—and it's going to take all of us to make progress on this problem and prove Vision Zero's value for our entire state. You can read my op-ed explaining why in full [here](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..pk5v0pfQvFVzX4ysZM9_CL1vPY2sAhDMdd-YNDRDr48/s/2950175210/br/246464936679-l).
* * *
---
|
## INDOT Needs to Hear From You About Plans for Our Interstates
|
---
On Wednesday,l I was proud to be one member of a great crowd who turned out to talk about centering and reconnecting our Indy neighborhoods as the state plans to move ahead with the I-65 Safety & Efficiency Project on the southeast side.
We have an opportunity in this process to do one of two things: make strides towards righting historic wrongs, or run the risk of reinforcing them. Dividing communities and expanding highways again and again is not the way to keep the economic and cultural heart of our state beating strong. It is my hope that public comment and well-developed alternative proposals being provided to our Department of Transportation will help guide us all to the right decisions.

INDOT needs to hear from you about this, too! You can learn more about the present design plans and provide written comment at [i65safetyandefficiency.com](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMDksInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vaTY1c2FmZXR5YW5kZWZmaWNpZW5jeS5jb20vIiwiYnVsbGV0aW5faWQiOiIyMDI0MDcyNy45ODIxMjAxMSJ9.TX67YKSZjej_nqfNcziMqu84w1ljGmSmeO3BVnVNGpQ/s/2950175210/br/246464936679-l), and explore what the experts at [Rethink I-65/I-70](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMTAsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vd3d3LnJldGhpbms2NS03MC5vcmcvd2hvLXdlLWFyZSIsImJ1bGxldGluX2lkIjoiMjAyNDA3MjcuOTgyMTIwMTEifQ.JdXCmgu8slxAWJz7gsxjnVZCOR70JfgvOS6Gp-UM-wg/s/2950175210/br/246464936679-l) are recommending to improve the project [here](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMTEsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vd3d3LnJldGhpbms2NS03MC5vcmcvb3Vyd29yay9zYWZlc3R1ZHkiLCJidWxsZXRpbl9pZCI6IjIwMjQwNzI3Ljk4MjEyMDExIn0.Gq-Meyo6zRgBdVTIkNzGvDvcmgHpAjfbpYKDOneAd2I/s/2950175210/br/246464936679-l).

## STORIES SHAPING OUR STATE
[](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..AwcP8o11e_ME_qZWQJ6URXsUDWSpd3e-u8e_p54Ztxw/s/2950175210/br/246464936679-l)[](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMTMsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vaW5kaWFuYXNlbmF0ZWRlbW9jcmF0cy5vcmcvIiwiYnVsbGV0aW5faWQiOiIyMDI0MDcyNy45ODIxMjAxMSJ9.IRDdDJ2U9JfzYNJ4AAsgzQM0c236-wTvjmYY06okOAE/s/2950175210/br/246464936679-l)[Public Comment Period for Phase One of HS Diploma Redesign Open through July 30](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMTQsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vd3d3LmluLmdvdi9kb2UvZGlwbG9tYXMvIiwiYnVsbGV0aW5faWQiOiIyMDI0MDcyNy45ODIxMjAxMSJ9.DQmzjyHSzsrX2mixy2PmN5kyCxufmlsUV-DIzCkYU0g/s/2950175210/br/246464936679-l)
The Indiana Department of Education has been developing updated high school diploma standards for Hoosier students. Those interested have through this coming Tuesday, July 30 to provide public comment to the IDOE on the initial stage of the process.
More information about the current proposals for the diploma redesign are available from IDOE [here](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMTUsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vd3d3LmluLmdvdi9kb2UvZGlwbG9tYXMvIiwiYnVsbGV0aW5faWQiOiIyMDI0MDcyNy45ODIxMjAxMSJ9.fg86-k5vK6ywe2Oehwjbi7SG53JfETyjGyiBLuj3VZU/s/2950175210/br/246464936679-l). The form to submit comment is available [here](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMTYsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vZm9ybS5qb3Rmb3JtLmNvbS8yNDE0MTY0NDczNzA5NTkiLCJidWxsZXRpbl9pZCI6IjIwMjQwNzI3Ljk4MjEyMDExIn0.2W49aprZE8c6ylgnzEi9Ho7vzyNIb6Le1PyeYs_AbZA/s/2950175210/br/246464936679-l).
[Higher Prices on Tampons, Pads Prompt Hard Choices for Americans](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMTcsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vbC5mYWNlYm9vay5jb20vbC5waHA_.CI7yNri-6oDB5mT6RtJleHtNarlzxx_BP3Hr4FeCym0/s/2950175210/br/246464936679-l)
I've supported cutting the tax on menstrual products for Hoosiers since I became a senator, and the fact that the price of these necessary items has increased as much as 40% in five years only underlines the importance of that effort. Indiana is one of only 20 states that still has this kind of tax. Let's finally listen to Hoosiers and repeal it in 2025.

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Yesterday, I released my final ad in our race against Wesley Bell, our
AIPAC-backed opponent. I wanted to use this final ad to give a platform to
Michael Brown’s family; to share their continued pursuit for
accountability for their son’s death. My opponent made them promises and
when he was elected, he broke them. But we can’t stop fighting for Michael
Brown. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240727-cb.osO8mv&refcode=em20240727-35832&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=35832%2E1203867%2EHpj6qR ]Everything is on the line, and I need your support. Will you
consider making a split contribution to Justice Democrats and my campaign
today? Your support is crucial in this final stretch.

On August 9, 2014, Mike Brown was killed by a white police officer in
Ferguson, Missouri, sparking a national movement to protect Black lives.
As an ordained pastor and registered nurse, I was on the front lines,
caring for injured protesters and bridging divides within our community.
For more than 400 days, I stood with Michael Brown Jr.'s parents. And took
their fight to Congress to demand systemic change.

Wesley Bell promised he would bring justice for Michael Brown Sr. and his
family. Bell never did, leaving the entire Brown family feeling more than
disappointed; they feel lied to.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240727-cb.osO8mv&refcode=em20240727-35832&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=35832%2E1203867%2EHpj6qR ]Still of Mike Brown Sr. with the text "Bell's Office Isn't Keeping it's
Promises" - STLPR, 07/19/2024

Wesley was also elected by the people of St. Louis because he promised to
reform the Prosecutor’s office. He failed, increasing the incarceration of
Black women. Now, as AIPAC and Bell’s Republican megadonors are spending
millions of dollars spreading Bell’s lies, I wanted to give Michael
Brown’s family the opportunity to set the record straight.

Our new TV spot, featuring Michael Brown Sr. and his daughter, gives a
voice to those most harmed by Bell’s lies. I was elected to be St. Louis’
Congresswoman to give a platform to those hurt by our broken systems. By
supporting this spot, we can continue to be a voice for justice and give
St. Louis the platform it deserves.

With just over a week until Election Day, Bell is attempting to sell out
St. Louis, as he lies about his record as a prosecutor, his time in
Ferguson, and what people who are truly seeking justice have been able to
accomplish in St. Louis, without his help. We must show that AIPAC and
their right-wing megadonors cannot buy a Congressional seat in St.
Louis. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240727-cb.osO8mv&refcode=em20240727-35832&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=35832%2E1203867%2EHpj6qR ]This is our final stretch to ensure every voter hears Michael
Brown’s story and Wesley Bell’s lies. Donate today >>

With your help, we can be the change Mike Brown's memory calls us to be.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240727-cb.osO8mv&refcode=em20240727-35832&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1004&akid=35832%2E1203867%2EHpj6qR ]Donate

In solidarity,

Congresswoman Cori Bush

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. | | | Peter, huge news from Leaders We Deserve’s first elected candidate: Nadarius Clark, who we helped get elected to the Virginia House of Delegates, just got his gun safety bill passed and signed — by a Republican governor, no less! [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T272f4529-0aaa-4cfb-ada8-796e3656e61a/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | | [Will you make an immediate split donation of $25 to Leaders We Deserve and Blue Amp Action so we can elect even more inspirational young leaders like Nadarius this November?](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td99a11d1-494f-4ad9-8e87-f2a1cf0e12fc/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Stopping gun violence is one of the biggest reasons Nadarius ran for office in the first place, and he knew that even with a Republican governor in office, something had to be done. Nadarius wasn’t willing to sit around and wait years for a Democratic governor with a spine to replace the NRA-backed Republican currently in office, so he started thinking about what he could get done under the current circumstances. He landed on a bill that offers tax credits to gun owners who buy gun locks and safes, so that no gun owner faces a financial barrier to keep their weapons safe and out of the reach of kids and others who shouldn’t be able to get them. Look, I get it — this may not be everything we wanted, but if even one life is saved as a result of this bill, it was worth it. And you can bet that when the current NRA-backed governor is replaced with a Democrat who’s willing to keep our communities safe, Nadarius will be there leading the charge to do even more. subject: There's NEVER been an openly transgender member of Congress

body:
"Today, anti-trans forces had to come before a trans person in the big chair – me."
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240727&t=1&akid=993%2E587540%2EeS6F4y)
"For years, trans people have had to go before anti-trans lawmakers in the big chair. Today, anti-trans forces had to come before a trans person in the big chair — me."
_— Sarah McBride_
Today is the 7-year anniversary of Donald Trump **reversing decades of progress** by BANNING transgender people from serving in the military.
**Back then, there wasn't a single transgender member of Congress to stand up to Trump... there still isn't, Peter. Which is why Leaders We Deserve has endorsed Sarah McBride in her race to represent Delaware in the U.S. House.**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240727?refcode=em20240727&refcode2=993_587540_eS6F4y&akid=993%2E587540%2EeS6F4y)
Sarah would be the FIRST-ever transgender member of Congress — after already being the first openly transgender person elected to a state senate seat. It is CRITICAL that we have her voice not just at the table but at the head of the table, as Republicans launch nonstop attacks on the trans community.
**[Please split a $5 donation between Sarah's campaign and Leaders We Deserve — so we can elect more progressive young leaders like her.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240727?refcode=em20240727&amount=5&refcode2=993_587540_eS6F4y&akid=993%2E587540%2EeS6F4y)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240727?amount=5&refcode=em20240727-993&refcode2=993_587540_eS6F4y&akid=993%2E587540%2EeS6F4y)**
Listen, I know as a supporter of Leaders We Deserve that I don't have to tell you representation matters. You're here because you KNOW it does.
So I won't explain why it's so important to end the absence of transgender people at the table in Congress. Instead, I'm going to tell you why Sarah is so damn amazing.
**She's been a political badass for years.** Sarah worked for the late Attorney General Beau Biden and served in the Obama-Biden White House. She also served as the national spokesperson for the Human Rights Campaign, the nation’s largest LGBTQ equal rights organization. In 2016, she became the first openly transgender person to address a major party convention when she spoke at the Democratic convention. And in 2020, she made history when she was elected to the Delaware State Senate.
**She's fought for progressive values as a state senator.** In her first term, Sarah passed paid family and medical leave for workers in Delaware — the largest expansion of the state's social safety net in decades. She's also successfully passed bills expanding access to health care, requiring mental health and media literacy education in public schools, promoting green technologies, and preventing lead poisoning in young people.
**She leads with love.** When Republicans went after transgender kids in her state, Sarah declared boldly, "To the trans young people and their families who are watching today... your government sees you. And for the first time ever, really understands you. You are loved, and you are worthy. You are part of the vibrant diversity that makes this state great."
**[Sarah is EXACTLY the kind of leader we deserve — so let's fight to make sure she wins this seat. Please split a $5 donation between her campaign and Leaders We Deserve right now (her primary is just 7 weeks away!).](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240727?refcode=em20240727&amount=5&refcode2=993_587540_eS6F4y&akid=993%2E587540%2EeS6F4y)**

Thank you,
David Hogg

Hey team —
Did you know that, according to Business Insider, two-thirds of young adults skipped the doctor’s office in 2024 because of high medical costs?
If that number sounds bleak but unsurprising, it’s because Millennials and Gen Z’ers have been hit hardest by insane healthcare costs.
Young people are borrowing insulin pumps, skipping hospital visits, and rationing potentially life saving medication because _they just can’t afford not to._
**It doesn’t have to be this way.**
We shouldn’t have to live our lives terrified of unexpected medical costs.
We shouldn’t have to skip necessary medical treatment to pay for rent and groceries.
And we _definitely_ shouldn’t have to put our lives on hold to take care of relatives who can’t afford professional caregivers.
The problem isn’t that we aren’t working hard enough. The system is the problem, **and if we raise our voices,_we can fix the system._**

body:
A top GOP super PAC is currently spending hundreds of thousands of dollars on ads in NY-17.
Team,

Peter, What a week it has been in American politics! _**I wanted to send you a personal note on where we are on the national level and how the week’s incredible news impacts Indiana. **_ It’s hard to believe that Vice President Kamala Harris has been a presidential candidate for less than one week. She has shattered fundraising records, volunteer sign-ups are through the roof, and the energy is real across the Democratic Party and across the country.

On her third day as a candidate, she visited Indianapolis to keep a long-standing engagement with the Zeta Phi Beta Sorority. The mood was electric and the excitement was off the charts! Our State Central Committee and full Indiana DNC delegation both unanimously endorsed Kamala Harris on Monday – and we were part of a handful of states that evening to help her secure the numbers to become the presumptive nominee. We are in touch with the DNC and the Harris for President campaign (has a nice ring to it, right?) and will work to harness this energy to drive more turnout in Indiana this fall. On the heels of our State Convention just two weeks ago, we now have a very strong ticket to take on far-right extremism and offer Hoosiers a better future across the board. Jennifer McCormick, Valerie McCray, and Destiny Wells will now join Kamala Harris on the ballot to make even more history in the Hoosier State this cycle. Indiana deserves better than Donald Trump, Mike Braun, Micah Beckwith, Jim Banks, and Todd Rokita. I call ‘em the MAGA starting lineup. I guess JD Vance could come off the bench, but he’s too busy making cringe worthy comments on TV. Our party made progress in 2023 by flipping some of Indiana’s larger cities and we need to build on that momentum over the next 101 days until Election Day. We can win statewide with the combination of great candidates running. We can flip four State House seats and break the supermajority. We can energize Hoosiers and stop settling for the bottom of the barrel in voter turnout. If we are successful this year, we can bring more balance to Indiana and become a state that serves its people and allows people to live their own lives – rather than banning healthcare, banning books, or rigging an economy that helps the select few over the common good. **[If you can chip into our 2024 Grassroots Fund sometime over the weekend at any amount, the team and I would be so grateful. Very big news — President Biden has promised to focus on cleaning up the Supreme Court during his final 5 months.
#
A lot of shit has gone down in the past few weeks, so this may have missed your notice:
**President Biden has promised to focus on cleaning up the Supreme Court during his final 5 months.**
Rumor has it he will support establishing term limits and an _enforceable_ code of ethics (the Supreme Court's current code is only valuable as toilet paper — because there's no enforcement mechanism).
This is great. But 5 months isn't a lot of time to get it done.
**[We've gotta make sure the work of cleaning up the construction site port-a-john that the Supreme Court has become continues past January 2025. Pitch in $5 or whatever you can to make sure we do just that.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240727?refcode=em20240727-9245&refcode2=9245_434096_he4aI3&akid=9245%2E434096%2Ehe4aI3)**

Why term limits? Seems pretty shady that 9 unelected people get lifetime appointments with NO accountability mechanism. I'm responsible to the people of Pennsylvania every 6 years. My colleagues in the House every 2 years. And the president gets their public performance review every 4 years.
And unlike the rest of federal judges, the Supreme Court doesn't have an enforceable code of ethics.
When Clarence Thomas and Samuel Alito got busted for accepting undisclosed gifts from millionaires and billionaires... nothing! Not even a slap on the wrist. And despite both of their partners expressing support for the January 6th insurrection, neither of them recused themselves from those cases.
It's not just optics either. Their rulings on everything from Trump's immunity to overturning Roe are clearly about what's best for their conservative sugar daddies and Donald Trump... not the American people.
**If it walks, talks, and smells like corruption... that's corruption. And it's why public opinion on the Supreme Court is in the shitter.**
**[I'm committed to cleaning up the court with Joe Biden and Kamala Harris — for his next 5 months and her next 4 years. Pitch in $5 if you're with us.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240727?refcode=em20240727-9245&refcode2=9245_434096_he4aI3&akid=9245%2E434096%2Ehe4aI3)**

clean_body: Very big news — President Biden has promised to focus on cleaning up the Supreme Court during his final 5 months. A lot of shit has gone down in the past few weeks, so this may have missed your notice: President Biden has promised to focus on cleaning up the Supreme Court during his final 5 months. Rumor has it he will support establishing term limits and an enforceable code of ethics (the Supreme Court's current code is only valuable as toilet paper — because there's no enforcement mechanism). This is great. But 5 months isn't a lot of time to get it done. Why term limits? Seems pretty shady that 9 unelected people get lifetime appointments with NO accountability mechanism. I'm responsible to the people of Pennsylvania every 6 years. My colleagues in the House every 2 years. And the president gets their public performance review every 4 years. And unlike the rest of federal judges, the Supreme Court doesn't have an enforceable code of ethics. When Clarence Thomas and Samuel Alito got busted for accepting undisclosed gifts from millionaires and billionaires... nothing! Not even a slap on the wrist. And despite both of their partners expressing support for the January 6th insurrection, neither of them recused themselves from those cases. It's not just optics either. Their rulings on everything from Trump's immunity to overturning Roe are clearly about what's best for their conservative sugar daddies and Donald Trump... not the American people. If it walks, talks, and smells like corruption... that's corruption. And it's why public opinion on the Supreme Court is in the shitter. ❤️ John John Fetterman U.S. Senator from Pennsylvania | | Email us: info@johnfetterman.com

| | Dear Fellow American,In baseball, there are statistics for everything. There's even a "stat" that reveals the worst player in baseball history. It's called "Wins Above Replacement" - or "W.A.R." for short - and it compares any given player with their possible replacement and which player will help you win more games. Worst of all time: someone I'll bet you never heard of. Greatest of all time: Babe Ruth (of course). **Here's the point. Right now, Californians are facing the prospect of being represented by a worst-of-all-time in the United States Senate in the form of radical Adam Schiff - who has been in Washington DC for the last twenty-three years.**He doesn't just need to be replaced. He needs to be defeated. **Or else California - and America - both lose.****[**That's why I'm asking you to rush me your emergency donation right away to join my campaign team today.**](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=e79cee6c0d5d4f60bc648a4d4cf74c79&_e=QSh3Vq4fLkhhUZhfQFj3g3aQJqhOUh8JMn7eYy4sceShxoae78pN2Tq4CZNhIZsOrR0DNkaIsNY1CfQCGHNJ8FW_Ko8Zzo_TXKfA5_qJhehBvrXUI3KKUhL0TRw7Mucgyj36Ol4oFEnk-oeZDTQBgOYD9_VtFe-F_8MYc5QsxUgC-nWfJqCjbBFy92EU-08hqTP-zVCVUiVkvH-zmB0pc_35V1aJOwPigAjTcE79a9gWzqVCoSJPMJ9D65VlqZCXcKB0JsSFlVTTJU7fVCAldTIeXycmpL1gAx6f8qrg3cTSPDORug_OsTpa9QjUKgFdnxF5rQgONo3V2O3J1OeSCYcB0XDyx6BKSO_pVJ47IiC2LxgWyk0bCXuCjoEV-Vop)** Adam Schiff's "stats" are truly abysmal:
---
* Lied to **300 million** Americans about the "Russia collusion" hoax
* Greenlit Biden's open border and the invasion of **10.5 million** illegal immigrants
* **Zero** : that's the amount of respect he has for our Constitution as evidenced by the fact his fingerprints are all over the weaponization of our justice system and by his relentless attacks on the Supreme Court with his support for "packing the courts" with liberal justices

---
When it comes to 2024... and when it comes to saving our state and our country... body:
So far, as of a few hours ago, we've identified 27,586 people who have said they would.

Friends —
As you read this, hundreds of volunteers are texting Democrats across the country asking them if they'd be willing to volunteer at some point in the upcoming election.
So far, as of a few hours ago, we've identified 27,586 people who have said they would.
That is data we'll share with local campaigns and state parties ahead of the election to help deliver victories for Democrats in the presidential race and all the way down the ballot.
In fact, our projections show that at this rate, we should get to 150,888 volunteers identified. That would be pretty cool.
But the gap between where we are and where we can land is getting more people to send text messages to those Democrats. People like YOU.

| After Israel Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu spoke to Congress, deranged Hamas sympathizers felt the only proper response was to tear down the American flag at Union Station in Washington, D.C., burn our flag, and raise the Palestinian flag in its place. I wasn’t about to let these people have the last word, so I went to Union Station that same night with my fellow veterans, the Speaker of the House Mike Johnson, and others to restore the American flag back to its proper place.
I’ll add something quite touching I witnessed that night. After we raised the flags, a homeless woman who was camped out next to the flag poles stood up and started singing the National Anthem with her hand over her heart. She’s clearly going through hard times, to say the least. And yet she stood up and demonstrated her love of country at that moment. It was an amazing moment.

Friend — I’m Eugene Vindman, the official Democratic nominee for Virginia’s 7th district. Give me just a moment to tell you the story of a phone call that changed everything. My brother Alex and I used to serve on the White House National Security Council. I was the senior ethics official on the Council. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89675709/488066266/191792663?refcode=240727&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1M2YyZjA2Ni0yYzRjLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=v5-dte52EflL9QK11Dv7KjCY0l8kUw22oLXamym5v9Y=) In 2019, Alex overheard a phone call in which President Trump attempted to extort our allies in Ukraine. Trump threatened to withhold military aid unless President Zelenskyy investigated his political rival. After Alex reported the call to me, we both blew the whistle on Trump. We reported Trump’s corrupt phone call up the chain of command, and it led to his impeachment. Even though the decision to blow the whistle on Donald Trump was the right thing to do, it cost my brother and me our military careers after the former-president retaliated against us. But I am not done serving. **I’m running for Congress in Virginia to fight back against Trump and the far-right Republicans who enable his abuse of power and attacks on our Democracy.** And more than that, I’m running to push our country forward across the board. To restore abortion rights everywhere, act on climate change, and lower costs for working families. So here’s the deal. If we win Virginia’s 7th district, we win a highly competitive swing district and make it that much more likely that Democrats take back the House. And if we take back the House, we can begin to make progress on those issues while safeguarding against any Republican attempts to roll back our rights. So please: [**Split a contribution between me and Serve America to support my campaign for Congress. Help us build a real grassroots movement in defense of democracy.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89675710/488066267/191792663?refcode=240727&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1M2YyZjA2Ni0yYzRjLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=v5-dte52EflL9QK11Dv7KjCY0l8kUw22oLXamym5v9Y=) Thanks for hearing me out. I hope I can count on your support. — Eugene Vindman

Peter,

I'm Tim Sheehy. Those are also my pronouns. _**SHEE – He.**_

**That's a joke** , but it shows the lunacy we're living with in Joe Biden and Jon Tester's America.

I'm a former Navy SEAL. My wife is a Marine. I led Americans in the battle to defend our country. Then, we came home to live the American Dream in Montana.

We started an aerial firefighting business in our barn. We created hundreds of jobs and protected our public lands and Montanans from devastating wildfires.

body:
Happy Friday, Peter.
Hey Peter, an update this morning from Team Gallego after an email we sent earlier this week.
Look, tomorrow we hit the hundred day mark — one hundred days until Election Day. That’s a critical milestone on its own. But right after it hits we’re going to have our primary election here in Arizona — another huge day.
These two critical moments come after a few of the most tumultuous weeks we’ve ever had. But even with all of this happening, we’re still behind on our goals.
We really, really need your help. Less than five percent of our supporters have made a donation to this campaign. Five percent have skin in the game.
Today, we’re asking you to join them.
[**Make your first online donation to Ruben’s campaign for U.S. Senate today. We really, really need you, Peter.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-july24.aPNp_S&refcode=em240727-1-full&t=1&akid=2713%2E734936%2EFJPQiZ)
[CONTRIBUTE](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-july24.aPNp_S&refcode=em240727-1-full&t=2&akid=2713%2E734936%2EFJPQiZ)

* * *

Peter, this isn’t looking good.
We were expecting a big surge in our fundraising after the events of the last few days. We’ve explained how important this race is, how the polls are tightening in Arizona, how some pollsters are actually projecting that Kari Lake will win this race, and how important this moment is for the nationwide effort to hold our Senate majority and defeat Donald Trump.
We thought that would be enough, but the donations just aren’t coming in the way we expected them to. Honestly, we’re at a complete loss. And we’re not sure how to proceed.
This is really serious, Peter. And the timing is terrible, because our primary election in Arizona is in ONE WEEK. If we don’t turn this around it could be a disaster — and not just for our campaign. If we fall short it makes it that much more likely that Trump wins in Arizona, too.
We try not to send emails like this, but we’re in real trouble.
[**We’re humbly asking you: If you’re in a position to contribute, to help us get back on track and defeat Kari Lake, make a donation right away. Anything helps. Please.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-july24.aPNp_S&refcode=em240727-1-full&t=3&akid=2713%2E734936%2EFJPQiZ)

We’ve explained how important this race is, how the polls are tightening in Arizona, how some pollsters are actually projecting that Kari Lake will win this race, and how important this moment is for the nationwide effort to hold our Senate majority and defeat Donald Trump. We thought that would be enough, but the donations just aren’t coming in the way we expected them to. Honestly, we’re at a complete loss. And we’re not sure how to proceed. This is really serious, Peter. And the timing is terrible, because our primary election in Arizona is in ONE WEEK. If we don’t turn this around it could be a disaster — and not just for our campaign. If we fall short it makes it that much more likely that Trump wins in Arizona, too. We try not to send emails like this, but we’re in real trouble. Growing up, his parents went bankrupt from his youngest sister’s medical bills and his family survived on the support of their friends and neighbors. After getting to college on a Pell Grant, Lucas decided to join the U.S. Marine Corps to honor the community that had given his family so much. He served for 13 years, including three deployments to Iraq and Afghanistan before later being stationed at the Pentagon. Once he left active duty, Lucas turned his focus to the corrupt politicians and corporate monopolies that dominate our economy and squeeze small businesses. He took on everyone from Big Tech and Big Ag to defense contractors and pharmaceutical companies. Now, Lucas is running to defeat January 6th coward Josh Hawley and take back Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat for real, everyday people. | | = Let’s just be clear here: Hawley’s January 6th cowardice isn’t the only reason he’s incapable of representing my home state. He’s put his money where his mouth is since day one — refusing to accept any money from corporate PACs, federal lobbyists, or Big Oil and Big Pharma executives. He’s running to be a real warrior for working Missourians, unbeholden to anyone other than the everyday people who elected him to office. Lucas will fight for investment in our state — rebuilding forgotten communities, creating jobs, and empowering workers. He’ll stand up to the attacks on reproductive rights by controlling politicians like Hawley. He’ll work to end the corporate grip on power in our country by banning insider trading and abolishing corporate PACs. And he’ll be accountable to real, everyday Missourians. Friend, bodily autonomy is a basic human right and fundamental to democracy.
I lived in a world before Roe v. Wade and celebrated the court’s decision in 1973 to make abortion accessible. That’s why I was devastated to see 50 years of progress rolled back in an instant when the conservative Supreme Court majority overturned Roe in 2022. Friend, My sister in service Representative Cori Bush is in a neck-and-neck race to remain by my side in Congress, fighting for an immediate and permanent ceasefire and demanding the rights of marginalized communities. Cori is everything we need in Congress. Her lived experiences and challenges in her life are the reasons why she fights so hard for her district. Cori is a nurse, a mother, a person of strong faith, an organizer, and now an unbought Congresswoman. She is under attack right now because she dared to stand up and say NO more bombing of children. She dared to say CEASEFIRE NOW. She dared to say that Palestinians deserve to live. **She says all of this because Cori believes in saving lives no matter faith or ethnicity.** Support Cori now. We can't keep letting them dehumanize and tear down the people who courageously spoke out against the government of Israel’s war crimes. St. Louis raised a congresswoman who doesn't back down to bullies. Cori is a nurse, a mother, a person of strong faith, an organizer, and now an unbought Congresswoman. She is under attack right now because she dared to stand up and say NO more bombing of children. She dared to say CEASEFIRE NOW. She dared to say that Palestinians deserve to live. She says all of this because Cori believes in saving lives no matter faith or ethnicity. Support Cori now. We can't keep letting them dehumanize and tear down the people who courageously spoke out against the government of Israel’s war crimes. St. Louis raised a congresswoman who doesn't back down to bullies. Let's not back down with her. Hi, Patriot.

I haven't introduced myself to you in a while, and I want you to understand why I believe what I do.

I was born and raised in Houston, TX in a military family. I was honored to accept an appointment to the United States Military Academy at West Point to begin my career.

[](http://links.wesleyhunttx.com/u/click?_t=6aa969a792e549699e2a6024aa3e4ace&_m=5b64375a31ad4e8c9479e60e1d8365e3&_e=DCK3Gq_LMR0krMPW8m3tx4hIBmxt4rFU-DTbUBuJLmlRJf--OwENaz0k5HINxPF3V42GCWyYZtY9ZAPOUkq6u5l9yQMg2RqyFS7AjyKbbLtC8fPUuBYyk44tcGc4JQvf31ZKgdQ0oDud8-GcHfUxiR-fRBsNJqdj6RjvcZVch1E54s7t8J1KfPytyfwvXQsbbFwCXtJ74lTw6BWMSVVsRQYfBt6INN7LDY80aMRdmgDGMbgZxjrKh9Xo341vMbpIvV7hV0MkqN9rwX1FFEb8qtqV0T7yR-dxTLJ5KkniXcReHFToQSAzjA9uCmaLMQgX)
In 2004, I received my commission in the U.S. Army and graduated with a Bachelor of Science degree in Leadership and Management with a Field of Study in Mechanical Engineering. After West Point, I spent eight years in the Army as an Aviation Branch Officer and AH-64D Apache Longbow helicopter pilot.

[](http://links.wesleyhunttx.com/u/click?_t=6aa969a792e549699e2a6024aa3e4ace&_m=5b64375a31ad4e8c9479e60e1d8365e3&_e=DCK3Gq_LMR0krMPW8m3tx4hIBmxt4rFU-DTbUBuJLmlRJf--OwENaz0k5HINxPF3V42GCWyYZtY9ZAPOUkq6u5l9yQMg2RqyFS7AjyKbbLtC8fPUuBYyk44tcGc4JQvf31ZKgdQ0oDud8-GcHfUxiR-fRBsNJqdj6RjvcZVch1HDWeyRvtKzEhlT1X9bmg0GndJOGI1L75job6iGlGM7RXwGKAKRqvh1ncNXMuE94k2IqIKK_lNZHauyy21blH0NCoqoFI6TgUA8tiXppbTXSCoJPgjzkdqEWXX_RnOxjHXVmfFHYVJ7S3MJTTIvfR9z)
I'm proud to share that my service included one combat deployment to Iraq, and two deployments to Saudi Arabia where I served as a Diplomatic Liaison Officer.

After honorably discharging as a Captain, I attended Cornell University and earned a Master of Business Administration (M.B.A.), a Master of Public Administration (M.P.A.) and a Master of Industrial and Labor Relations (M.I.L.R.).

I never believed that changing Washington would be easy, but graduating from West Point and serving in the United States Army, being deployed to combat zones, and flying Apache helicopters over Iraq has prepared me for tough fights and big challenges. I truly believe nothing is more worth fighting for than our great country and our way of life in the Houston area.

My family is everything to me. My wife Emily and I have two daughters and one son, Victoria, Olivia and Willie Parish Hunt 2nd.

[](http://links.wesleyhunttx.com/u/click?_t=6aa969a792e549699e2a6024aa3e4ace&_m=5b64375a31ad4e8c9479e60e1d8365e3&_e=DCK3Gq_LMR0krMPW8m3tx4hIBmxt4rFU-DTbUBuJLmlRJf--OwENaz0k5HINxPF3V42GCWyYZtY9ZAPOUkq6u5l9yQMg2RqyFS7AjyKbbLtC8fPUuBYyk44tcGc4JQvf31ZKgdQ0oDud8-GcHfUxiR-fRBsNJqdj6RjvcZVch1FxUSdwodOvT3CerZS3R029LM8jUjb-9VT83BZdN1Z9fxwwvfFc82G5Bp5WsL-1as3f34_lVtDI8YVJqCRulxwZR7eaPD6Lb5xWdalZNqXeNNfEHULrQIfzrfSaSkTIFbnXW4lfYZe2y-xjA8z8e0jW)
As the great-great grandson of a slave, serving as a Congressman in the U.S. The House of Representatives is truly in the wildest dreams of my ancestors. It's the honor of a lifetime to serve this great country and the Great State of Texas, but I can't keep doing it without your support.

| | Dear Fellow American, American civics education, and specifically the teaching of American history, is at a crisis point. In K-12 schools nationwide, false narratives are being constructed, and content is being cherry-picked to fit an ideological (and frankly anti-American) agenda. Maybe you've even seen this happening in your local schools. As a result, we are faced with a choice: will we allow our children to be indoctrinated using curricula developed by anti-American ideologues and promoted by Left-wing education bureaucrats? Or will we insist that our children are taught honestly, using a curriculum that presents a fair, unbiased, and comprehensive view of our nation's history? We must insist on the **latter** , both for the sake of truth and for the sake of our children and America's future. For this reason, we have produced the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ --and I'm writing to ask your help in promoting this curriculum to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide. **What is the _Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_? ** The**_Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_** is a K-12 history and civics curriculum that covers the triumphs and tragedies of American history fairly and comprehensively. This curriculum has been designed not by activists or ideologues but by teachers and professors at Hillsdale College--and we are making it available **free of charge**. To be clear, the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ is not a _slap-dash_ response to the efforts of anti-American ideologues to indoctrinate our children. It is a 2,000-page, 85-lesson curriculum based on decades of studying American history. Developed over 18 months of intense and focused effort, its roots extend as far back as the beginning of Hillsdale College in 1844. And we need your help to make the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ available to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide...and to make it available **free of charge** so that it will have the greatest impact. _We have set a budget goal of $800,000 to promote the _**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum**_ and our other outreach efforts--including _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and our classical K-12 charter school initiative_. That's an ambitious budget, and we need to get started as soon as possible. One reason why your support really matters: **Hillsdale College refuses to accept one penny in taxpayer support --not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans**. This makes our work uniquely dependent on the support of citizens like you--citizens who agree with Hillsdale's mission on behalf of liberty. We remind ourselves daily of Hillsdale's 180-year-old mission--to provide "sound learning" of the kind needed to preserve "the inestimable blessings of civil and religious liberty." With that mission in mind, we produced the _**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum**_ --and now we need your help to promote it nationwide. Will you take this opportunity to _**support the _Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_ and our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty**_**?** Understanding that a proper education is vital to the preservation of liberty--and that the anti-American indoctrination now being forced on too many American children poses an existential threat to liberty--I hope you will make your most generous tax-deductible gift today. **I 've included a secure link for your convenience here: ** _**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-hillsdale-1776-curriculum](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=155c86a51c584b11b138a0b6ec72b72b&_e=wvZokweXKyRl_BS95V3WWzpV_T_9Ox2uxO4zMTSYIBiag11GHNQWzL0KJKmULF4zTElMBffUeHz1oa36cqiHE4vAXt6V2t5Zlni5wwy5ZK20a9D0qkktmhPGk5sPNfkp2MuIMQYngn-1WsNSsFogXJIUqFP0O_kiQEMHiAnQN-xSOTQtDzfXMkDa0iAThoN6szxZW4gFzLcR5ZVCvHDhxtd-d23IjdsKqlu-pgvsOniQaZWC3WU_wgFGRWNdSnx70dUs6TsR8MMVgdhFw1xrsM3_acV0RWXbCJ54Z9jm00RlZbXzhj5ZVKVcXBT49LRpKUg4qoNoPlsyvqotfHXnYOATySjvV3kJ4G7mYdLvWJd2UZC7W8cfomniYgg75u9XM9oCihmX7yzhZzohDh2wfCO_xK-1h5Wk3XOuONheGCM%3D)**_ Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to hearing from you. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
