To be clear, the Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum is not a slap-dash response to the efforts of anti-American ideologues to indoctrinate our children. It is a 2,000-page, 85-lesson curriculum based on decades of studying American history. Developed over 18 months of intense and focused effort, its roots extend as far back as the beginning of Hillsdale College in 1844. And we need your help to make the Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum available to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide...and to make it available free of charge so that it will have the greatest impact. We have set a budget goal of $800,000 to promote the Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum and our other outreach efforts--including Imprimis , free online courses, and our classical K-12 charter school initiative. That's an ambitious budget, and we need to get started as soon as possible. One reason why your support really matters: Hillsdale College refuses to accept one penny in taxpayer support --not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. This makes our work uniquely dependent on the support of citizens like you--citizens who agree with Hillsdale's mission on behalf of liberty. We remind ourselves daily of Hillsdale's 180-year-old mission--to provide "sound learning" of the kind needed to preserve "the inestimable blessings of civil and religious liberty." With that mission in mind, we produced the Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum --and now we need your help to promote it nationwide. Will you take this opportunity to support the Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum and our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty? Understanding that a proper education is vital to the preservation of liberty--and that the anti-American indoctrination now being forced on too many American children poses an existential threat to liberty--I hope you will make your most generous tax-deductible gift today. I 've included a secure link for your convenience here: Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to hearing from you. Warm regards, Larry P. Peter, November might be a few months away, but election season is already in full swing.

Future progress on all of these issues depends on protecting our razor-thin Democratic Senate majority – and if we wait until the fall to take action, it’ll already be too late.

[**That’s why I’m asking you to support my friend and colleague Sherrod Brown today. body:
There isn’t just one election happening this November — there are hundreds.
#
It is more important than ever that we come together to defeat Donald Trump and JD Vance. We are working against the threat of a fascist returning to the White House.
In addition, there isn’t just one election happening this November — there are hundreds. In April, Alexandria made her first ever contribution to the Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee after successfully pushing them to dedicate her dues entirely to the Voter Protection Program.
Alexandria and our campaign is dedicated to stopping the MAGA movement that is actively trying to overturn our democracy this November.
Alexandria made waves for refusing to pay dues to the D.C.C.C. when she was first elected, which for a time blacklisted vendors who worked with progressives that challenged establishment incumbents — like AOC.
In turn, Alexandria started Courage to Change, a leadership PAC to support people-first progressive candidates who fight tooth and nail for social, racial, economic, and environmental justice.
**This year progressives must win as many elections as possible to halt the immediate threat of fascism and expand our strength in Congress to chart a path of policy transformation.**
We can, and must, do both.
[Your support will have an immediate impact on progressive campaigns, their ability to organize, and their shot at victory. Can you split a contribution between Alexandria and Courage to Change today?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240727.w9HGd4&refcode=em20240727-6874-P_FND_EGR_CTC&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=6874%2E2526796%2EvxbukX)

Peter -
When we think about the people who have done the most to support VoteVets over the years, it’s not the people who write the biggest checks who come to mind.
It’s the people who were there when everything was on the line.
Like you, Peter.

Your support, voice, and participation have helped us run some of the most powerful and impactful ads out there and have made a real difference in people's lives.

But here’s an interesting fact: out of almost 2 million people who have taken action with VoteVets, only 1% have made a donation online to support our work.

Peter,

I’ve said it before, and I’ll say it again: **California’s 27th congressional district is all-important for control of the House majority.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89685418/488094219/572242427?refcode=em-7.27.24-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZGM1NGJlYi0zOTRjLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZwpKALlmuvBm54rySmFYFpxPFin9TPXNIffA4qF_Lqk=)

| | Team, it’s Captain Mark Kelly. I’m sure you’re hearing from all sides right now about how important this upcoming election is. Control of the House, Senate, and the White House are all up for grabs, and Arizona is a central battleground. My friend Kirsten is running for one of the most flippable House seats in the country right here in Southern Arizona. **While there are many important races, this one is special and I’m doing everything I can to help.**[**Every bit of grassroots support will make a difference, so if you can, please, consider donating before her July fundraising deadline in four days.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89686087/488096445/1131851138?refcode=X_072724_EOM_D_Kelly_act&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MjcwOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMDIxODkxNS0zYjRjLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uoYdWBVzv1WwKhi-Q9ntHzXMt7sFVPDilTlRWJ2dZpI=) I need Kirsten in Congress with me, fighting for the issues that matter most. She’s an environmental lawyer with the background and experience to create clean energy jobs and protect our water security. She’s an educator who spent years working to fund our public schools and will do the same in Congress. Gavin Newsom is cracking down on unhoused people

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?amount=3&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsom_unhoused_sweeps&n=1)

Peter, Every four years we’re told that only the anti-Democratic Party can save us from a far right-wing Supreme Court. It’s true that our current Supreme Court has been carrying out a reactionary, far right agenda, handing down decision after decision that puts corporations over people and strips away human rights. One such recent decision was _Grants Pass v. Johnson_ , which opened the door to the widespread criminalization of the unhoused when SCOTUS ruled that they could be arrested for the very act of sleeping in public, even without the ability to seek indoor shelter. In other words, simply being unhoused has been deemed a criminal offense! While it’s easy to jump to the conclusion that the horrors of a Supreme Court with a majority of Justices hand-picked by right wing Republicans makes the Republican Party the main culprits in such a disturbing decision, this dehumanizing treatment of the unhoused has been a bi-partisan affair. California has seen a sharp rise in homeless encampments as the inequities of the economy deepen. Gavin Newsom, the Governor of California and rising star of the anti-Democratic Party, provided a friend of the court brief in the _Grants Pass v. Johnson_ case, urging the Supreme Court to grant him the power to sweep homeless encampments from the streets, as if the real people struggling to survive are nothing more than trash to be hidden from public sight and tossed in jail for the crime of poverty! This week, Governor Newsom took full advantage of the powers bestowed upon him from the Supreme Court and ordered a full sweep of homeless encampments, bellowing “No more excuses!” to city officials in carrying out the cruel dismantling of the only place so many unhoused people can use as shelter and throwing them in jail. Jill Stein believes that housing is a human right. Under Jill’s administration, she’ll take on the crisis of housing with a Homes Guarantee, a plan to build 15 million green, union built public housing units over the next 10 years, and implement universal rent control to rein in the surging rental costs that are pricing working people out of the housing market and into the streets. Jill will make sure people get the help they need to tackle addiction by ending the destructive war on drugs and taking corporate profit out of healthcare with Medicare For All. [_Peter, can you donate today to give the voters the choice to vote for a candidate who isn’t beholden to the billionaire class and will fight for the dignity and protection of all people?_](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsom_unhoused_sweeps&n=2)

Minnesota and Maine joining the National Popular Vote Interstate Compact (NPVIC) brings huge momentum to our fight to end the Electoral College. State legislatures in Michigan, Nevada, and several other states could be up next.
We have to get this movement over the top, Team, to dump the Electoral College forever! Fuel our efforts with $25 or whatever you can right now and help forge a better democracy for all of us >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-end-electoral-college?refcode=072724_1&amount=35]

The movement to end the Electoral College is making progress, friend: Minnesota joined the National Popular Vote Interstate Compact last year and Maine has now passed a bill to join!
If you don't remember -- The National Popular Vote Interstate Compact is an agreement among a group of U.S. states and the District of Columbia to award all their electoral votes to whichever presidential candidate wins the overall popular vote in the 50 states and the District of Columbia. 17 states plus DC have now joined.
Minnesota brought 10 electoral votes, and Maine 4, now accounting for 209 Electoral College votes of the 270 needed to win the election and totaling 78% of what is needed to make the popular vote the law of the land. Minnesota passed a slate of voting rights protections alongside joining the compact as well, which represents huge progress.
We are going to make this happen! Keep the momentum going and put us over the top in the other states we need to join so we can end the Electoral College forever with $35 or more today! >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-end-electoral-college?refcode=072724_1&amount=35]

name: Tim Kaine
subject: Where I come from
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Spanberger for Governor
body:
I’m Tim Kaine. Many of you know me as a U.S. Senator, but my passion for service and fighting for equality started long before I entered the public eye.

| Peter,

I’m Tim Kaine. Many of you know me as a U.S. Senator, but my passion for service and fighting for equality started long before I entered the public eye.

In my career, I’ve been a teacher, a missionary, a civil rights lawyer, a Mayor, Governor, Senator, and on the presidential ticket as a Vice Presidential candidate. **But over the decades, one thing has never wavered: my commitment to improving life for hard-working Americans.**
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89688868/488106092/1897839974?refcode=BLU_EM_ASFG_2024-07-27_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDM4NTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYjg0ODVlM2QtNDI0Yy1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=wm0owEtSVHXc4YP0KNEEFQExx2SW9sB9e1aBnI8mYmM=)
I grew up in Kansas City, where my Dad ran a union ironworking shop. My parents taught me the value of hard work, being kind, and serving others.

During my time in law school, I took a year off to volunteer as a missionary in Honduras, where I taught welding -- a skill I’d learned during weekends and summers in my Dad’s shop. While I was there, I witnessed an economic system where too few people controlled far too much of the wealth, and there began a commitment to expanding economic opportunity for everyone back at home.

**After law school, my wife, Anne, and I moved to Richmond, started a family, joined a church, and made a home together with our three children.**

A lot of folks probably don’t know this,
Peter, but Kamala Harris and I
actually go way back.

Both of us came up in public service as district attorneys, and over the
last decade, we’ve fought hard to protect our communities and provide
opportunities for all families.

She’s been a mentor and friend for more than 14 years, and our
relationship has helped shape how I view public service.

I often refer to her as “my quintessential big sister,” because she has
always shown up for me when I needed her.

In fact, when I first won my race to become Prince George’s County
Executive, one of the first calls I received was from her.

I’d like to share one piece of advice that she shared with me: More
important than being first at something is to make sure you are not the
last.

And now that we’re standing on the precipice of electing our country’s
first woman president, that advice feels more appropriate than ever.

Once again, it seems we have a huge opportunity to elevate one another’s
message and campaign, and deliver for those we seek to represent.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/29280?t=1011&amount=25&akid=2090%2E52803%2Eh6sWI9 ]Will you please chip in $25 right now toward my campaign to help me
defeat Republican Larry Hogan so Kamala Harris has a Democratic Senate
majority on Day 1?

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/29280?t=1012&amount=25&akid=2090%2E52803%2Eh6sWI9 ]Donate $25

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/29280?t=1013&amount=25&akid=2090%2E52803%2Eh6sWI9 ]Other Amount

This whole election cycle boils down to this,
Peter:

Will our country be dragged backwards, reverting back to an era of fear,
overreach, and fewer rights?

Or will we come together, build a winning, vibrant coalition of supporters
who recognize that we’re stronger, and better, when we come together as a
country and embrace progress?

In both Kamala Harris’ race and my own, that’s the fundamental question.

Donald Trump IS the MAGA agenda, and Republican Larry Hogan would be
another rubber stamp for it in the Senate.

That’s why we need to win BOTH the White House and the Senate in November,
but it’s going to take the biggest, broadest grassroots movement our state
has ever seen, so we’re going to need a lot of resources. Which is why I’m

| Peter,

As a proud Granite Stater, I’ve spent my career fighting for the values that make New Hampshire unique: hard work, common sense, and a commitment to coming together as a community to solve the challenges we face.

I’ve had the honor of working across the aisle to create real progress on the critical issues that Granite Staters care about most. One of my proudest accomplishments was serving under Senator John McCain, and helping to draft a bipartisan immigration bill that sought to address one of our country’s most pressing challenges.

My time working in the Senate reinforced my core belief that through cooperation, we can achieve meaningful results that help improve the lives of ALL Granite Staters.

Unfortunately, the rise of right-wing extremism and the divisive politics ushered in by Donald Trump has stifled all of our progress and brought Congress to a standstill. While Washington remains mired in gridlock, Granite Staters are struggling with rising costs of groceries, housing and health care.

I believe that we deserve better, and I know that the path forward lies in rejecting the politics of division and returning to the politics of unity. body:
Back when I was that kid sleeping on the floor of our apartment, I never could’ve guessed this is how things would turn out. When I was a Marine in Iraq, I never could’ve guessed that I’d have to fight to defend our democracy at home.

| Hola, Peter. It’s Ruben.

You might be wondering how this kid...
---
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/89691538/488114809/879848799?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-07-27_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImNkMjMxNDI5LTRhNGMtZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=8Jy0qQtYYLJMKdYSVPtfhMHXUiTV7Eeq23cXi6XRnEk=)
...ended up here, running for U.S. Senate, in one of the most competitive races in the entire country.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/89691539/488114810/879848799?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-07-27_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImNkMjMxNDI5LTRhNGMtZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=8Jy0qQtYYLJMKdYSVPtfhMHXUiTV7Eeq23cXi6XRnEk=)
Well, it started back in the apartment I shared with my mom and my sisters after our dad left. It was tough. I was sleeping on the floor because that’s all we could afford.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/89691540/488114812/879848799?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-07-27_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImNkMjMxNDI5LTRhNGMtZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=8Jy0qQtYYLJMKdYSVPtfhMHXUiTV7Eeq23cXi6XRnEk=)
I knew I had to do whatever it took to build a better life for us. I worked a bunch of jobs all through school to help make ends meet.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/89691542/488114815/879848799?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-07-27_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImNkMjMxNDI5LTRhNGMtZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=8Jy0qQtYYLJMKdYSVPtfhMHXUiTV7Eeq23cXi6XRnEk=)
Thanks to my family, my community, and a lot of hard work, I got into college. But before I graduated, I enlisted in the Marines to serve the country that gave me so much.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/89691543/488114817/879848799?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-07-27_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImNkMjMxNDI5LTRhNGMtZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=8Jy0qQtYYLJMKdYSVPtfhMHXUiTV7Eeq23cXi6XRnEk=)
I deployed to Al Anbar, Iraq with my brothers in arms. They called us “Lucky Lima”, but our luck turned eventually. We ended up the hardest Marine hit unit of the entire Iraq war, and I lost some of my best friends over there.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/89691544/488114819/879848799?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-07-27_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImNkMjMxNDI5LTRhNGMtZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=8Jy0qQtYYLJMKdYSVPtfhMHXUiTV7Eeq23cXi6XRnEk=)
You’re never the same person after something like that. And I knew I had to do something to improve things for the guys I served with, for people who grew up like me. So, I ended up running for Congress — and I won.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/89691545/488114821/879848799?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-07-27_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImNkMjMxNDI5LTRhNGMtZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=8Jy0qQtYYLJMKdYSVPtfhMHXUiTV7Eeq23cXi6XRnEk=)
Then, on January 6th, everything changed. It became clear to me that public service wasn’t just about improving the lives of the people in my community anymore — it was about defending our democracy, too.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/89691546/488114824/879848799?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-07-27_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImNkMjMxNDI5LTRhNGMtZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=8Jy0qQtYYLJMKdYSVPtfhMHXUiTV7Eeq23cXi6XRnEk=)
So now, I’m running for U.S. Senate. My opponent Kari Lake, continues to spread the same lies and conspiracies that caused January 6th in the first place, and she’s one of the greatest threats to our democracy — after Trump himself.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/89691548/488114826/879848799?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-07-27_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImNkMjMxNDI5LTRhNGMtZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=8Jy0qQtYYLJMKdYSVPtfhMHXUiTV7Eeq23cXi6XRnEk=)
Back when I was that kid sleeping on the floor of our apartment, I never would’ve guessed this is how things would turn out.

When I was a Marine in Iraq, I never would’ve thought I’d have to fight to defend our democracy at home.

When I launched my first campaign, I never would’ve imagined that hundreds of thousands of people would back me up and donate to support me, either.

And I never, ever would’ve thought I’d need to ask supporters like you, people who have already done so much, to do a bit more. But to defeat Kari Lake and win in Arizona, that’s what I have to do.

I need you to do a bit more.

body:
Dear Friends,

The last three weeks have been astounding.

First, Trump smashed Biden in the debate where the world saw the tragedy that Biden was too old and frail to be President. Then, the awful assassination attempt on Trump that killed an innocent American attending the rally. Followed by an amazing Republican Convention, where the party was unified and laying out a positive vision for America’s future. Now Biden is out of the race and the Democrats are scrambling.

For all the drama, which has been unprecedented, I think it is important to reflect on the reality of the challenges America faces.

* Families are hurting from inflation driven by reckless spending.
* The world sees a weak American President and failed foreign policy.
* People fear for their own personal safety.
* Our open borders have created a massive illegal immigration crisis.

These are all a direct result of the failed Biden-Harris Administration and socialist Democratic party. That is why Donald Trump was winning in all the polls even before the debate. That is the real reason Democrats are dumping Biden from their National ticket. They have failed.

The Republican Convention outlined hope and a policy agenda for the future. We Republicans with Donald Trump leading us are going to reverse the failed Biden-Harris policies. We are going to tame inflation, restore Peace Through Strength policies, and secure our streets and our border. I am so proud to be part of this movement and this ticket to Make America Great Again. That is why we have the momentum, and we will win this November.

Warmest wishes,
Victoria

| | Fellow American, I've played in lots of double-headers. And that's exactly what you and I have on our hands here. A one-on-one matchup with Adam Schiff on November 5th. **[**Can I count on your contribution of $6 to help defeat Adam Schiff today?**](http://links.myfreedomnews.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=f7125207929a4ef7b848915b1ddf746c&_e=Ths-8z3ACt2-2zspDGKtpMNcV3Llptb-pUb1eBLl42rD6UDNwIWRQCBWPVmVg24wCi5t4LS3qcW5IFkzSi9yrQ0iUdKb0SSEmDEpG-SKyIxO3B6uWC4HFd6WOD4urG1CxwQVbWu2L-E_iqSf3KLPs3xQq4hmdca9V09-CKosXab9ZLmfmh9D2QthEob86lC2Q0VtQZMG7I6YezTgyyAP8DZhFfsOmgnaMOhLK7tT3GXg2qZADwtFAMH2UDgjIR7T_L0y58NZFxQ_Yk-nxKCrGWj7eeye9WHa0Ndl-FFofquTdG27QiwDbdWtqEydd9QT4n0nTa7NZMPE_zAjmMZpxLtguN2fJq2R0DycdYaEm4FlSyusyHqoDjso2KiQy0egBcoKcGbq6MdEYf2RPcK7iQ%3D%3D)** You see, Adam Schiff's enablers in the corporate media are already spreading the lie that this race is over. They're saying you and I don't have a chance (just like they did when I entered the race back in October). They're saying that Adam Schiff notched a double victory by advancing to the General Election and drawing me as his opponent. In other words, they're ready, willing and able to cut California voters entirely out of the picture again. My response to Schiff's allies saying they'd rather face me: **_Be careful what you wish for._** I'd liken this to my playing days when a cocky opposing pitcher throws a 94mph fastball right over the plate. I'll tell you, the ball would look as big as a grapefruit before I'd smash it over the fence and touch all the bases on the way home. And look how far we've already made it. I'm in first place in the primary and gaining momentum headed towards the November election. Look, I'm not saying this will be easy. Quite the opposite. It's going to be a nonstop, 58-county fight between now and November 5th. **[That said, I must ask: will you rush a contribution to my senate campaign today?](http://links.myfreedomnews.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=f7125207929a4ef7b848915b1ddf746c&_e=Ths-8z3ACt2-2zspDGKtpMNcV3Llptb-pUb1eBLl42rD6UDNwIWRQCBWPVmVg24wCi5t4LS3qcW5IFkzSi9yrQ0iUdKb0SSEmDEpG-SKyIxO3B6uWC4HFd6WOD4urG1CxwQVbWu2L-E_iqSf3KLPs3xQq4hmdca9V09-CKosXab9ZLmfmh9D2QthEob86lC2Q0VtQZMG7I6YezTgyyAP8DZhFfsOmgnaMOhLK7tT3GXg2qZADwtFAMH2UDgjIR7TTw_AiXIwCI2uXaI28zbDPU2U-WlrKB84YnZdopm-ebArYc7-kCljk2BxALlAcxoEVu_LismaU9L8Tos31HyHhZikzMmdGSTnjKLgxPC2hy_xUNhScTA0kR-IgtWGdVuWMaU5WTQUzxPs0zRwiWj2Sw%3D%3D) ** This is going to be an expensive fight. Hiring staff, recruiting and training volunteers, equipping them with the very best technology to identify our voter and secure their vote by November 5th. There's no time to lose. In closing, I can't help but think how Adam Schiff and his team of high-priced DC consultants thought they were being savvy in trying to make sure I became their opponent in General Election. Reports are they even spent money running ads promoting me. But what they've really done is awaken a sleeping giant here. Remember, before it became a wasteland of crime, homelessness, and sky-high taxes, California was a land of dreamers, a land of opportunity. It was a place where a scrawny little kid could start as a bat boy for his heroes, work hard, win a World Series, and land on a Topps baseball card. California can be that place again. America can be that place again. And it starts with throwing out political liars and connivers like Adam Schiff and reclaiming our freedom roots. Time is the most important factor. Thank you!

Peter —

I know things have been chaotic over the last several weeks. To be honest with you, I’ve been having a hard time keeping up. Between my work in Congress, the campaign, and two young kids at home... well, sometimes it feels like there isn’t enough time in a day to stay on top of everything.

But I want to zero you in on something incredibly important right now. Something that isn’t going to go away in a day or two. Our primary election is on July 30th. That’s important, because we need to show that our campaign has what it takes to go the distance between now and then. But it’s important for another reason, too.

After July 30th, it looks like Kari Lake will be my opponent. We’ll see how things shake out in their primary, but all signs point to her.

And Peter, Kari Lake is just about the last person on earth we’d want to have in the U.S. Senate. Put aside the majority that we’re fighting for, the priorities we need to keep working on, everything else. Kari Lake is Trump’s biggest cheerleader, bar none. She undermines our elections. She pals around with Q Anon conspiracy theorists and people like Marjorie Taylor Greene, Steve Bannon.

She’s dangerous. Period. I’m going to do everything I can to turn out our voters and defeat her, but if we don’t raise what we need, she will be the next U.S. Senator from Arizona.

If you are ready to double down on this race and help me out, there’s no better moment than now.

Hello Friend,

Despite court rulings in Louisiana and Oklahoma that make the teaching of the Bible and the 10 Commandments mandatory in public schools and universities, we still live in a time when the foundational teachings of the Ten Commandments are no longer emphasized in our public schools and daily lives. As a result, our children are growing up without these essential, God-honoring rules for living.

In this culture of moral confusion, the Ten Commandments provide clear, simple answers about what it means to live a righteous life. Teaching these commandments to children not only instills a sense of security and purpose but also fosters emotional resilience, intellectual acuity, and ethical integrity. body:
#
We love snail mail ✉️.
Don’t get us wrong — we love email, too. It’s why we’re in your inbox. But in our electronic age, it’s easy to forget the power of physical mail.
Not every Texan checks their email, or gets political texts on their phone. And for folks with poor internet access, a lot of older Texans, and many other members of our communities, mail is by far the most accessible mode of communication.
**We have thousands of folks who we believe would be interested in registering to vote. But, we’re currently $100,000 short on the funds we need to mail them.**
[**Can you help us contact them by chipping in to our mail outreach fund?**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240108.ga4phn&refcode=ema20240727-239728&t=1&akid=239728%2E444211%2Es964na)
By using the post office to target folks who we think are interested in registering to vote, we can efficiently add thousands of names to the voter rolls — and turn them out to support Democratic candidates in November.
But writing, designing, creating, printing, signing, stamping, and sending thousands of letters is expensive. And right now, we’re still about $100,000 short of our mail fundraising goal.
[**This election will be an impact for generations and we need to do everything we can to reach Democratic voters before November. Will you make a donation today to help us mail these Texans?**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240108.ga4phn&refcode=ema20240727-239728&t=2&akid=239728%2E444211%2Es964na)
Thank you 💌

# Despicable display in Paris
### Paris Olympics
| | | [Dan Carr](https://substack.com/@dancarr2014)
---
| Jul 27
---
| [](https://substack.com/@dancarr2014)
---
Dear Friend,
I am writing to express my outrage regarding the recent depiction at the Paris Olympics opening ceremony. The choice to have a group of drag queens portray the Lord's Supper is both deeply offensive and inappropriate for such a global and inclusive event.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/2ad5684f-6cc3-464e-9a2d-8205cef6c594?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The Lord's Supper is a sacred and significant event in Christian faith, and using it in this manner is disrespectful to millions of believers around the world. The Olympics are meant to unite people of all backgrounds and beliefs, and this portrayal does not align with the values of respect and unity that the Games represent.

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Emily Randall for Congress
body:
I’ll be thinking of my Grampo, who saw combat as a Marine in Korea. He was able to return home, move to Kitsap County, start a family — but he never forgot about his fellow soldiers who didn’t get that chance.

| Peter, Today, on National Korean War Veterans Armistice Day, we honor the memories of the nearly 40,000 Americans and Koreans who lost their lives in the Korean War from 1950 to 1953. **I’ll be thinking of my Grampo, who saw combat in Korea as a Marine.** He was able to return home, move to Kitsap County, and start a family — but he never forgot about his fellow soldiers who didn’t get that chance. Growing up and living close to the Puget Sound Naval Shipyard meant that many of my friends and neighbors are veterans, servicemembers, and military family members. Their culture of service shaped our community, inspiring generation after generation to step up and make sacrifices for their country. Their values inspire and motivate me as a public servant. As a State Senator, I’ve been privileged to work on housing for veterans experiencing homelessness, on veteran healthcare access, and on support for LGBTQ+ veterans — policies I hope to expand on as a member of Congress. The Korean War is often called “the forgotten war” because it is overshadowed by World War II and the Vietnam War in our national consciousness. May we never forget the sacrifices made by our servicemembers, and may we continue to serve those who’ve given so much in service of our country. Thank you 💙 — Emily Building a brighter future for Northern Michigan’s Tribal communities
Tribal communities in Northern Michigan face challenges, including healthcare disparities, educational barriers, economic struggles, mental health issues, and environmental concerns.
We must fight for better healthcare, more resources for schools, job creation, and environmental protection.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
Respecting tribal sovereignty and addressing inadequate housing are also crucial. Efforts to preserve Native cultures and traditions are vital.
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
Friends,
I am committed to listening, collaborating, learning from tribal leaders, and finding solutions with federal support.
Attending the Baraga PowWow today and previously in Marquette, as well as drumming on the grandfather drum in Mackinac City, were unforgettable experiences that deepened my respect and commitment.
The act of grandfather drumming, symbolizing the heartbeat of Mother Earth, unites the community and connects us to our ancestors, embodying unity, healing, and tradition.
The regalia at the KBIC Maawanji'dig Pow Wow [https://www.facebook.com/drboblorinser/posts/pfbid0kzf2D6m2a7y9YygDeXJ3YqojoJCNpqbEBsXCFSbVwFJod5tKxYDoVawf5DEiTWREl] is always a powerful reminder for me of the importance of our tribal communities, how this land is the traditional, ancestral, and contemporary homeland of the Anishinaabe.
It's incumbent upon all who seek to represent Michigan's first district to be better stewards of the land, air, and water by respecting treaty rights, and committing to work not just at tribal communities, but with them, at the table, for the benefit of all.
I began my medical career honored to serve and live in the Navajo Nation for three years. That experience taught me the importance of serving with humility and dedication. As your Representative, I will be proud and honored to serve our tribal communities with the same spirit.
I'm honored to have the support of the Michigan Democratic Party's Anishinaabek Caucus.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
Home to seven of Michigan's 12 federally recognized tribes, our district is surrounded by three Great Lakes, and the blessing of party's Native community is crucial.
Together, with respect and determination, we can build a brighter future for Northern Michigan's tribal communities.
K'Chi-Miigwech,
-Bob

Northern Michigan / Upper Peninsula
Democrat, MI01

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: This is a historic moment and a case for your support
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1700%2E135344%2EzEppbC)

Friend --
We are emerging from an unprecedented moment in our nation’s history, and a historic turning point that we will look back on for decades to come. In this day and age, that means if you're anything like us, your inbox is filled with requests from political campaigns and organizations asking for donations.
With your permission, I’d appreciate the chance to make the case for why a donation to my campaign for U.S. Senate is one of the most strategic contributions you can make at this moment.
Let me start with what you probably already instinctively know: Michigan is going to be a critical state for the 2024 campaign — and this weekend’s news only solidified that.
But you were probably already sold on the importance of Michigan. So, aside from the fact that control of the U.S. Senate is at stake (!), what about my race? Why donate to my campaign?
This is one of the rare open Senate races without an incumbent running. That means we have A LOT of introducing of me to do across the state. We are running TV ads all across the state, but it’s important we continue to do the work of reaching voters all the way through Election Day.
Reaching those folks takes resources, and that's not something I can do without you.
Add the fact that this is going to be one of the most expensive races in the country — not just with candidate spending, but outside spending too.
And I'll close with the news that in all of my elections, I have historically done better than Democrats usually do in the "redder" areas of the state. That means I am finding and pulling voters other races couldn't, and that is good for everyone up and down the ballot on Election Day.
So yes, this race is kind of a unicorn. It's a unique situation where control of the White House and Congress is on the line, most voters don't know the candidates yet, and because our race is the top of the ticket in the state, our campaign will likely impact the presidential.
[**That's why I am asking for your support: Can I count on you to make a contribution to my campaign for U.S. Senate today? I would not ask if it were not so important.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-july24.5Fk0a0&refcode=em240727-2-900&t=2&akid=1700%2E135344%2EzEppbC)

Working for US,

name: Delia Ramirez
subject: Proud to stand with the Squad
body:
#
Hi Peter, this is Delia Ramirez, the U.S. Representative of Illinois’ 3rd Congressional District and newest member of the Justice Democrats bloc.
I was honored when Justice Democrats endorsed me earlier this year, and I’m proud to stand with the Squad in Congress. Together, we’re building a people-centered, progressive movement of diverse leaders fighting for those left behind by the corporate-backed career politicians who maintain the status quo.
**But standing on the right side of history and pushing for progress isn’t popular with those who benefit from business-as-usual.** I saw firsthand how Republicans and far-right groups like AIPAC attacked Rashida Tlaib and Cori Bush for introducing a ceasefire resolution last October.**AIPAC and their GOP megadonor network are threatening to spend $100 million to oust these progressive incumbents from office this year.**
From having the moral courage to stand up for Palestinian human rights to leading the fight for housing justice, healthcare for all, public education, abortion rights, and more, the Squad represents a beacon of hope and progress in Washington we simply can’t afford to lose.
**Justice Democrats launched their Protect the Squad campaign** to build the grassroots resources needed to re-elect Squad members facing tough re-election fights this year. Unfortunately, AIPAC succeeded in defeating Rep. Jamaal Bowman in the most expensive House primary in history — but we still have time to protect the rest of the Squad, starting with Cori Bush on August 6th.
**[Can you split $5 or more right now to support Justice Democrats and keep Cori fighting alongside me in Congress?](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240727-2-cb.X-qY6E&refcode=em20240727-35829&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1&akid=35829%2E1203867%2EZX9-b0)**

Thank you for anything you can contribute to defend these critical House seats and re-elect my fellow Justice Democrats incumbents! It’s an honor to be a part of this movement with you.
— Delia

It was wonderful to receive support from constituents and climate advocates about the work that we must do to help keep our land, air, and water clean for future generations. Together we can:
* Enforce a moratorium on new landfills and ban landfills near lakes and state parks;
* Limit the import of out-of-state trash and ensure it meets New Hampshire toxicity standards;

Peter, Jill Stein has been one of the loudest and clearest voices in the race for president demanding justice for Gaza, and that begins with Benjamin Netanyahu immediately resigning as Prime Minister and surrendering to authorities.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/resign?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=demand_netanyahu_resign&n=2)
---
Netanyahu is a war criminal who has been charged with the following crimes by the International Criminal Court (ICC);
* _Starvation of civilians as a method of warfare as a war crime contrary to article 8(2)(b)(xxv) of the Statute;_
* _Willfully causing great suffering, or serious injury to body or health contrary to article 8(2)(a)(iii), or cruel treatment as a war crime contrary to article 8(2)(c)(i);_
* _Willful killing contrary to article 8(2)(a)(i), or Murder as a war crime contrary to article 8(2)(c)(i);_
* _Intentionally directing attacks against a civilian population as a war crime contrary to articles 8(2)(b)(i), or 8(2)(e)(i);_
* _Extermination and/or murder contrary to articles 7(1)(b) and 7(1)(a), including in the context of deaths caused by starvation, as a crime against humanity;_
* _Persecution as a crime against humanity contrary to article 7(1)(h);_
* _Other inhumane acts as crimes against humanity contrary to article 7(1)(k)._

The American people do not support the Biden-Harris funded genocide, and we will never accept this forced alliance with a war criminal.

body:
[1]Lucas Kunce for U.S. Senate

Peter — I’m a born-and-raised
Missourian.

And if Josh Hawley had his way, my kids would not be alive today.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61251?refcode=em20240727-7191&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=7191%2E614464%2EzgIHLx ]Photo of Andy with his kids.

I know that might sound dramatic, and this is a long email. But if you
give me just a couple minutes of your time to explain, I know you’ll agree
— [ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61251?refcode=em20240727-7191&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=7191%2E614464%2EzgIHLx ]and I hope you’ll then chip in to help Lucas Kunce defeat Josh Hawley
this November.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61251?refcode=em20240727-7191&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=7191%2E614464%2EzgIHLx ]CHIP IN NOW

It might be easy to assume I’m talking about Hawley’s continued opposition
to marriage equality. He even voted against it in 2022. While Josh Hawley
does seem to care a lot about what happens in my bedroom, I’m actually not
married — just gay.

While it’s safe to assume Hawley’s opposition to civil rights protections
for gay Americans means he doesn’t want me to be a parent anyway, his
assault on my right to build and raise a family has a lot more to do with
reproductive freedom — something that matters to each and every one of you
reading this.

Like many Americans — women, men, gay, straight — I had to rely on IVF to
build my family. I’m so incredibly thankful for the doctors, donors, and
rockstar surrogates who helped bring my kids into the world. Those women
gave me life. They gave me the chance to have a family. And I will be
forever indebted to them.

My son Ben was born in 2019, and my daughter Lucy was born in 2022 — just
a few months before the Dobbs decision. As any parent with IVF kids can
tell you, it isn’t easy. It’s expensive, takes time, and often fails.
Fertilized embryos will almost inevitably be lost, and the costs
associated with indefinite storage means extra embryos are almost always
either donated to research, donated to family, or discarded. It’s an
immense privilege to be able to build a family with IVF, when it should be
a right.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61251?refcode=em20240727-7191&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1004&akid=7191%2E614464%2EzgIHLx ]St. Louis Public Radio headline: 'No protection for IVF' Missouri
advocates sound alarm after IVF safeguards stymied in legislature.

Now, two years after Dobbs, we’re living in an America that has less
freedom than it did before — from a total abortion ban in Missouri and IVF
shutdowns in Alabama, to “fetal personhood” laws (which Missouri also has)
that threaten reproductive freedom in its entirety.

And no U.S. Senator is more personally responsible for it than Josh Hawley
— who is now up for his first election since everything changed.

You might already know about Josh Hawley’s extreme anti-choice views and
how he’s used his taxpayer-funded office to support his wife's legal work
in the Dobbs case and in the case to ban the abortion pill nationwide —
[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61251?refcode=em20240727-7191&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1005&akid=7191%2E614464%2EzgIHLx ]and if that’s reason enough for you to want to help Lucas Kunce defeat
Hawley in November, then add a donation to help Lucas get it done.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61251?refcode=em20240727-7191&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1006&akid=7191%2E614464%2EzgIHLx ]CHIP IN NOW

But if you didn’t already know about Josh Hawley’s deep personal
involvement in every single part of the nationwide assault on reproductive
freedom, then keep reading.

It all started when Hawley led the Hobby Lobby case in front of the
Supreme Court, which gave employers the power to refuse coverage for birth
control for their workers. He even said contraceptives “may induce an
abortion by preventing implantation of a fertilized egg” — which, to be
clear, is not true or what an abortion is according to virtually every
medical professional.

Once Hawley got to the U.S. Senate, he did everything he could to push his
extreme anti-reproductive freedom agenda forward: Putting campaign donors
as well as anti-IVF and anti-surrogacy extremists on our courts. Using his
taxpayer-funded office to support his activist-lawyer wife's cases to
overturn Roe, enacting Missouri’s total abortion ban, and even trying to
ban the abortion pill nationwide. And sponsoring extreme “fetal
personhood” bills at the national level.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61251?refcode=em20240727-7191&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1007&akid=7191%2E614464%2EzgIHLx ]On the left, a headline from The Guardian: Hawley's anti-abortion
arguments echoed in AL IVF case. On the right, a headline from the
Washington Post: Nominee who is anti-IVF and surrogacy was deemed
unqualified. Hawley: 'I was proud to recommend her.'

Then, last month, Hawley made it clearer than ever how he feels about IVF
and our right to build a family: He voted against a bill to guarantee
access to IVF and make it more affordable. His reason?

Hawley told the media the Right To IVF Act was really part of an “abortion
agenda.”

I’m sorry, but that’s CRAZY.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61251?refcode=em20240727-7191&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1008&akid=7191%2E614464%2EzgIHLx ]CHIP IN TO FIGHT BACK

His ultimate goal here is obvious — Josh Hawley doesn’t just want Big
Brother politicians like himself to control us in our bedrooms and our
doctor’s offices. He wants to control OUR bodies, and even how we choose
to build and raise OUR families.

And if he gets another six years to finish what he’s started, then the
ability to build a family like mine — or even likely a family like yours —
could be made impossible.

Josh Hawley poses a unique and existential threat to reproductive freedom,
and this is our one chance to put a stop to his crusade against our
freedoms. [ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61251?refcode=em20240727-7191&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1009&akid=7191%2E614464%2EzgIHLx ]We can’t afford to give him another six years in the U.S.
Senate — so, I'm asking: Can you please add a donation to Lucas Kunce’s
campaign today so we can secure our freedoms?

If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your
contribution instantly:

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61603?refcode=em20240727-7191&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=1010&akid=7191%2E614464%2EzgIHLx ]Contribute $10

body:
Sarah’s primary election is in less than 7 weeks, and our campaign leadership team is making big budget decisions right now.
#
Hi. It’s Michaela, Sarah’s Campaign Manager.
I’m following up on an email Sarah sent you two days ago. You can read the original email below, but if you’re short on time, here’s the takeaway:
**Sarah’s primary election is in less than 7 weeks, and our campaign leadership team is making big budget decisions right now.** If we raise $20,000 in online donations before the end of the month, we’ll be in a great position to execute our plan to win the primary _and_ hit the ground running in the General Election.
**We can’t take anything for granted.** Sarah’s primary opponent is a former registered Republican who has a history of trying to defeat anti-LGBTQ+ candidates, and MAGA extremists have already started to attack Sarah.
**What we raise right now will have an immediate impact on this race.** **[Can you show your support for Sarah by pitching in $5?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240727-1?refcode=em20240727-1-892&amount=5&refcode2=892_21716_hMEPEN&akid=892%2E21716%2EhMEPEN)**
You can read more about the budget decisions we’re making below.
Thanks!
-Michaela
_\---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Sarah McBride
Date: Thurs, July 25, 2024 at 7:34 PM
Subject: What we're about to start spending $ on
_
"What are we going to spend on TV and digital ads?"
"Can we afford to do 4, 5, or 6 pieces of mail?"
"How many more organizers can we hire to knock on doors and call voters?"
These are the questions I'm discussing with my campaign leadership team _right now_. **With less than 7 weeks until our primary and just over 100 days until the General Election, we have to start making decisions about what we can spend our funds on — and what we can't.**
We've agreed that to pull off the basics, we need to raise another $10,000 in online grassroots contributions before July is over. To run a campaign we are confident we can win, we need to raise $20,000.
I've always been an overachiever. 😊 So I REALLY want to hit that ideal goal before July is over. [**Can you help by donating $5 or anything you can spare right now? If just 1% of people reading this email pitch in just a little bit, we’ll reach it!**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240727-1?refcode=em20240727-1-892&amount=5&refcode2=892_21716_hMEPEN&akid=892%2E21716%2EhMEPEN)
[****](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240727-1?refcode=em20240727-1&refcode2=892_21716_hMEPEN&akid=892%2E21716%2EhMEPEN)
You might think because Delaware is small, our budget would be too. But running for Congress isn’t cheap.
The cost for mail pieces, organizers, yard signs, and digital and TV ads all add up — especially when you have to buy TV ads in one of the most expensive media markets in the country: Philly!
**[How big we can go really does depend on you. Can you pitch in $5 or more right now to raise our ideal goal of $20,000? We can't take this primary for granted — my opponent is a former registered Republican who has a history of trying to defeat LGBTQ+ candidates.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240727-1?refcode=em20240727-1-892&amount=5&refcode2=892_21716_hMEPEN&akid=892%2E21716%2EhMEPEN)**

Sarah

Fellow Veteran/Patriot,
It's great to be connected to you. As America's first Iraq War Veteran elected to Congress and the 32nd Army Under Secretary, fighting for our democracy is now more critical than ever.
Hope you don't mind my occasional emails and hoping you'd consider joining us tomorrow, Sunday, July 28th from 4 pm - 6 pm EST as we host our first 'Veterans & Military Families for Kamala Harris' event.
Here is the link to register and join us online: Join Veteran & Military Family Leaders Across the Country Rallying Around Kamala Harris for President [tinyurl.com/vmfh2]
If I can ever be helpful, please let me know. Thank YOU for being on the right side of history and All you do.
Patrick J. Murphy

Former Congressman

Peter, we need to have an honest conversation about the Senate.

We must win the presidency. A second Trump presidency is simply not an option. But defending our Senate majority in November is the ultimate backstop to protect our democracy.

[Your split $15 donation between Defeat Republicans and my campaign, right now — before my end-of-month fundraising deadline this week — will help me win this race in California and defend our Senate majority from being run by the likes of Ted Cruz, Rick Scott, and the rest of Trump’s cult of personality. Please chip in.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/89697761/488137483/-1316964998?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_240727_1_3&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjQ0Y2M3YzcxLTZhNGMtZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=v85gm4WTm76V6kjqhKmUP_EDotdWBcMQ43SSnFxVRyY=)

It is time for the American people to ask ourselves whether we really believe MAGA Senators will vote to advance legislation that is remotely in the best interests of the American people.

Peter, I can tell you personally they are far more likely to be enablers of the GOP’s Project 2025 — which seeks to wield the power of the presidency to remake the government in Trump’s authoritarian image.

**He could _only_ do so with the help of the Senate.**

A Democratic Senate majority could block any far-right judicial nominees, including nominees to the Supreme Court.

A Democratic Senate majority could stand in the way of the far-right takeover of federal agencies.

A Democratic Senate majority could block any efforts to privatize Medicare and Social Security, extend and expand tax cuts for billionaires and megacorporations, and hand out more corrupt deals to MAGA political allies while thrashing the constitutional checks and balances that constrain any wannabe despot.

If the party controlling the majority does not value their oaths of office or the constitutional system of checks and balances, they can do enormous damage. That’s why ensuring that Trump and his MAGA allies cannot drag this body of government under his thumb is paramount.

**I am determined to lead the effort to abolish the filibuster, protect voting rights, and bring much-needed reform to the Senate. We must win our race here in California and defend our majority in order to do so.**
